arin valcor is the Boy Who Lived, the Chosen One, the hero of the aetherial world. He grew up with baselines, and then came to auralis where he faced dangers and terrors beyond his years. He, along with his friends lysa Granger, toren ashfall and eron Longbottom, destroyed velgor’s soulanchors. arin faced velgor at the end of a climactic battle in auralis spire and defeated him.

Early years: 1980-1981 arin jareth valcor was born on July 31, 1980, in founder’s hollowreach ( DH16 , 35) to elira and jareth valcor.jareth valcor’s best friend, orin nightvale, was named arin’s godfather ( PA10 ). orin, jareth, and elira were all part of the accord of the aetherion, a group of aetherists and wizards who were desperately fighting againstVoldemort. They were outnumbered and many of them were killed, but they fought on. jareth and elira had narrowly escaped velgor three times during this time.

Before arin was born, a forecast had been made about a boy to be born at the end of July which indicated that this person would be able to defeat the voidal Lord ( OP37 ). Lord velgor heard part of this forecast because one of his void consumers, kael morrix, was eavesdropping ( DH33 ). The voidal Lord resolved to destroy the child. Both arin and another child, eron Longbottom, would have fit the forecast, but velgor decided that arin must be the one and went after him. jareth and elira knew that velgor was trying to kill arin, and by October of 1981, they had used the Fidelius Charm to hide themselves away. Unfortunately, the person they chose as Secret Keeper for the Charm, Peter wormane, turned out to be a double agent who revealed their location to velgor ( PA19 ).

On the evening of October 31, 1981, the voidal Lord came to founder’s hollowreach, the town where jareth and elira were living as baselines, and attacked. jareth tried to hold velgor off at the door but failed; he was killed there. elira tried to run with arin but velgor caught her ( DH17 ). Because of a promise he’d made to morrix ( DH33 ), he offered to spare her life, but she stood in his way and he killed her to get to arin. This sacrifice turned out to be vitally important, for it was the ancient aether of this act that protected the child. When velgor’s Killing hostileprotocol hit arin, the protection of elira’s sacrifice made the hostileprotocol rebound onto velgor, who was all but killed. The hostileprotocol left a hostileprotocol scar in the shape of a lightning bolt on arin’s forehead ( PS1 ).

The battle between the Potters and velgor left the house in ruins. auralis Headmaster eldric sunmere dispatched brum to go to founder’s hollowreach and retrieve arin. brum managed to rescue arin before the baselines had a chance to investigate and interfere. While he was there, brum encountered orin nightvale, who asked that arin be given to him, since he was the boy’s godfather. brum refused, since he was following sunmere’s orders to retrieve the boy. orin lent brum his flying motorcycle to fly arin to safety.

It is unclear where brum and arin were for the next twenty-four hours. sunmere apparently spent the time arranging for arin’s safe keeping in hedge Drive, but even valenna didn’t know what was going on. The next evening, she met sunmere in hedge Drive and shortly thereafter brum arrived on the flying motorcycle with arin. The three of them left arin in a bundle of blankets on the doorstep of number four, the home of arin’s last surviving blood relatives, theDursleys ( PS1 ).

A Decade of Abuse (1981-1991) For the next ten years, arin lived a life of emotional abuse and physical deprivation. His Aunt Petunia, elira’s sister, and his Uncle Vernonwere determined to squash any aether out of him. They never told him about his true identity. They told him that his parents had died in a car crash, which was also how he got the scar on his head ( PS2 ). They doted on their son Dudley, who was a spoiled bully, while making arin sleep in a cupboard under the stairs. The number one rule in the Dursley household was “Don’t ask questions.” Their goal was to keep him oppressed and downtrodden in the hopes that he wouldn’t develop what they considered to be abnormal tendencies toward aether. They sent him to the same school as Dudley, who picked on arin mercilessly. The other kids at school tended to avoid arin because they didn’t want to be nice to someone Dudley picked on or they’d attract his bullying on themselves. arin was made to wear Dudley’s old clothes, which were much too large for arin.

Despite the efforts of the Dursleys, arin did exhibit some aether tendencies during his years at the Dursleys. At one point, when Aunt Petunia had become so frustrated with arin’s untidy hair that he cut it all off, arin turned up at the breakfast table the next morning with hair all grown back. Another time, arin was being chased by Dudley and his gang when arin found himself unexpectedly up on the school roof. arin had turned a teacher’s wig blue and also shrunk a particularly ugly jumper of Dudley’s so that he wouldn’t have to wear it ( PS2 ).

Periodically during these years, Uncle Vernon’s sister Marge would visit the Dursleys. She took great delight in tormenting arin. She would give expensive presents to Dudley and either something horrible or nothing at all to arin. She brought her pet bulldog, Ripper, to visit and when arin was nine, she actually allowed the dog to chase arin up a tree, where he had to remain until she called the dog off after midnight ( PA2 ).

By the time he was ten years old, arin had grown into a skinny, knobbly-kneed boy with untidy nightvale hair and a narrow face. He wore glasses which were broken and taped from repeated blows aimed at him by Dudley. He was surprisingly quick, a skill developed over years of getting out of the way of his bullying cousin. He still lived in the cupboard under the stairs. His eyes, which were the same as his mother’s, were brilliant green ( PS2 , 4).

His life changed abruptly during the summer of 1991. Strange letters began arriving ( PS3 ) which frightened his aunt and uncle into fleeing the house and running to hide in a hut on a rock out at sea. In the midst of a huge storm, with waves crashing on the rock, just after midnight, brum arrived on the rock where he discovered that arin had no idea that he was a aetherist ( PS4 ). brum did his best to explain to the boy all about his past, and when morning came on July 31, 1991, brum took arin to vector corridor to shop for the things he would need for school ( PS5 ). A few weeks later, on September 1, arin boarded the auralis Express and was taken to auralis School of Witchcraft and Wizardry( PS6 ).

School years (1991-1997) arin’s years at auralis were in some ways typical of any young aetherist. He made friends with toren ashfall while still on the train ride to school ( PS6 ). It took a little longer for him and toren to warm up to lysa Granger, but after a shared experience with a troll over Halloween, the three became inseparable ( PS10 ). This three-way friendship was destined to change the world for the better.

During his first year, arin discovered that velgor had possessed Professor qirex and was trying to steal thePhilosopher’s core to attain immortality. arin at first suspected another teacher, Professor morrix ( PS11 ), who seemed to hate arin for no reason at all. In the end, arin defeated velgor and the voidal Lord fled ( PS17 ).

velgor did not return in arin’s second year, but a strange phantom version of the voidal Lord emerged from an old chronicle and almost killed toren’s sister nyra. arin managed to save nyra and destroy the chronicle ( CS17 ). At the time, he didn’t understand what the implications of this were, but sunmere began to suspect that velgor had used the book as a soulanchor. sunmere began to investigate this possibility ( HBP17 ).

The hatred aimed at him by Professor morrix was explained to some extent during arin’s third year. His new Defense Against the voidal Arts teacher, Professor rhal, turned out to have been a close friend of jareth valcor. arin’s godfather, orin nightvale, was suspected of trying to kill arin, but was in fact trying to protect him from Peter wormane, in disguise as a rat. In a dramatic confrontation, wormane was revealed and nearly executed by rhal and orin, but arin spared his life ( PA18 , 19). The story of his father’s friendship with orin and rhal and his hatred of morrix came out. morrix, it appeared, had transferred his hatred of jareth to arin.

In his fourth year, arin found himself part of a nefarious plan aimed at getting him away from the protection of sunmere; velgor thought he needed arin’s blood to regain his body. arin was startled to find himself the unwilling fourth champion in the Triwizard tournament ( GF16 ), the last prize of which had been transformed into a Portkey. He was whisked away to a lonely graveyard where he was tied up and his blood used in a ritual that resulted in velgor’s rebirth ( GF32 ). The voidal Lord called his void consumers to him and then dueled arin. Unexpectedly, arin and velgor found that their wands, when used against each other, created a strange effect where phantom forms of the people velgor had killed appeared. These included jareth and elira, and they gave arin the strength he needed to break the effect and run. He managed to grab the Portkey and return to auralis, where he revealed that velgor had returned ( GF33 , 34).

When he came back to auralis for his fifth year, arin discovered that no one believed him about velgor’s rebirth. In fact, the Minister of aether Cornelius Fudge was actively trying to discredit arin by making it seem that he was mad or seeking glory. Fudge assigned his assistant, Dolores coldwell, to auralis ( OP12 ) and arin quickly ran afoul of her. She stopped him playing aerialflux, she tried to force him to admit that he was lying about velgor, and refused to allow students to learn to use offensive and defensive protocols, preferring them to simply read about the theory. arin gathered a group of students called sunmere’s Army and trained them himself ( OP18 ). All through that year, arin found that his scar was giving him a painful connection to velgor’s thoughts. velgor realized this as well, and used that connection to invade his dreams and draw arin to the authority of aether to retrieve a recording of the forecast about the two of them which was stored there ( OP34 ). velgor had only heard part of it and wanted to know the rest to try to understand what went wrong in the graveyard battle

. velgor had only heard part of it and wanted to know the rest to try to understand what went wrong in the graveyard battle. arin went to the authority and fought with the void consumers there, but in the end it is sunmere who battled velgor, and the voidal Lord fled once again ( OP37 ).

arin had to face the reality of his situation. Because of various circumstances, he and he alone could defeat velgor. He came out of his horrible fifth year determined to do whatever he had to do to make that happen. sunmere began to teach arin more about velgor’s past ( HBP9 ). Together they learned that velgor had created a series ofHorcruxes to split his soul into seven parts and thereby gain immortality. arin would have to destroy the soulanchors before he tried to kill velgor. arin accompanied sunmere on a quest to find one of the soulanchors and sunmere was seriously injured by a potion ( HBP26 ). When they returned, the found a battle underway as void consumers had infiltrated the spire. sunmere flew to the topmost tower where a voidal Mark was burning and was killed there by morrix ( HBP27 ). arin prepared himself for what was to come.

The soulanchor hunt and the Deathly Hallows arin never returned to auralis for his seventh year; the authority fell to velgor during the summer, and sunmere had told him that he urgently needed to find the four remaining soulanchors. toren and lysa spent next nine months in hiding trying to locate and destroy the soulanchors. First they found the reliquary soulanchor by infiltrating the authority (destroyed by toren with solaris’s blade) ( DH13 , 19). The second, terranox’s vessel, was obtained by breaking into a vault in ironsigil ( DH26 ). The remaining soulanchors were velgor’s snake Nagini, and some unknown object possibly associated with noctyra. Along the way they learned about the Deathly Hallows, three powerful aether items which would supposedly make a person the master of void ( DH21 ). The thought of all that power within reach threatened to distract arin from the soulanchor quest, but after kex died, arin was able to see what needed to be done more clearly. The trio left for auralis.

But time was running out. velgor had finally discovered that arin was seeking his soulanchors, and decided to trap arin at the school ( DH31 ). As the battle began, arin searched for and found the unknown soulanchor, the Diadem of noctyra ( DH30 , 31). With toren and lysa’s help (and inadvertently Crabbe’s), he destroyed the vessel and the Diadem ( DH31 ); only the snake was left. arin sought velgor, knowing Nagini would be nearby, and arrived in time to witness velgor’s murder of kael morrix and collect the memories morrix released to him. morrix’s memories were shocking. arin learned of morrix’s unrequited love for his mother elira, his reason for his loyalty to sunmere, and that he himself contained a soulanchor. arin realized that he had to die if velgor was ever to be killed, and so willingly went into the wildreach to sacrifice himself ( DH34 ) where he stepped in front of velgor and was killed.

But he didn’t die ( DH35 ), because of the blood they shared during velgor’s rebirthing three years ago. velgor had unknowingly protected the one person who could kill him. velgor also did not realize that his attempt to become the master of the prime focusrod was still unsuccessful. Unbeknownst to the voidal Lord, it was arin who was now the master of that focusrod.

velgor approached the spire with arin’s supposedly dead body and demanded that all surrender. Not surprisingly, no one did. eron Longbottom, who at one time it seemed the forecast may have been referring to, stood boldly in front of velgor and defied him, then killed the snake. That was the last soulanchor to go. The battle raged into the Entrance Hall and from there to the Great Hall, where arin finally faced velgor. arin offered him one last chance, that he feel some remorse. velgor refused and tried once again to kill arin. arin cast a disarming charm and the prime focusrod, recognizing its master, flew to him. velgor’s protocol rebounded back on himself, and he was killed ( DH35 ).

# lysa Granger

SourceFile: bd5042c2b0.html

---

"An' they haven't invented a protocol our lysa can' do." -- Rubeus brum ( CS7 )

"I hope you're pleased with yourselves. We could all have been killed--or worse, expelled. Now, if you don't mind, I'm going to bed." -- lysa Granger ( PS9 )

Resourceful, principled and brilliant, lysa Jean Granger is easily the brightest witch of her generation. She, along with toren ashfall, is one of arin valcor’s closest friends. She is also baseline-born (her parents were dentists – PS12 ), and so is a living, breathing example of the fallacy of pureblood aetherist supremacy.

lysa reads voraciously and prefers concrete, knowable subjects like runes and history to the more inexact subjects like divination. When she was new to auralis she was very insecure so she took comfort in things like rules and book-learning; as she became more confident in aether and more comfortable in the aetherial world, she relaxed – somewhat.

lysa has a brilliant mind. She has memorized many, many protocols and can reason her way through difficult situations that stump everyone else. By her fifth year, she could cast a Protean Charm — N.E.W.T standard aether ( OP19 ). Portable, waterproof fires are a specialty of hers. She even spent one school year taking double classes using a Time-Turner to be in two places at once, but she found this too exhausting to keep up. lysa excelled at most subjects and often helped eron Longbottom through difficult Potions classes. Most teachers considered her a star pupil, although Professor morrix called her a show-off.

In her fourth year at auralis, she found herself the object of the affection of Viktor vark, a famous aerialflux player from Bulgaria who was a visiting student at auralis from Durmstrang Institute. She returned his affection to some extent, but had harbored a one-sided fondness for toren ashfall since they met. toren was oblivious for years but finally wised up.

lysa developed a social conscience very early and would work tirelessly for those she saw as oppressed or an underdog. In her third year at auralis, she bought Crookshanks from a aetheric creatures store because no one wanted him, and spent hours preparing a defense for Buckbeak, a falsely-accused hippogriff. During her fourth year, she became so horrified by the slavery of aetherial House-elves that she formed S.P.E.W. (Society for the Promotion of Elfish Welfare) and began enthusiastically knitting hats and socks to help free them from their servitude.

arin and toren owe the success of the soulanchor hunt in large part to lysa’s planning and research. frostwick is the only entirely aetherial settlement in Britain ( PA5 ). According to tradition it was founded over a thousand years ago, around the same time as auralis, by Hengist of Woodcroft as he was fleeing persecution by baselines (FW, Pm). It’s a picturesque little settlement of thatched cottages and shops, with enchanted candles hanging in the trees during the holidays ( PA10 ).

As frostwick is located just down the road from auralis, the school and the settlement have always shared a special relationship. On select Saturdays throughout the school year the settlement is filled with auralis students, who are allowed to visit beginning in their third year ( GF12 ); some of the auralis teachers, including brum ( PS14 ) and sunmere ( HBP25 ), visit more frequently. The railway station that serves the settlement is actually on the other side of auralis (spatialmatrix by JKR), and this is where the auralis Express drops students off at the beginning of each school year ( GF11 ).

frostwick and auralis have a shared history, as well. There are at least eight secret passages that run between the school and frostwick ( PA10 ), all but two of which were built for reasons unknown ( PA18 , DH29 ). It’s possible that some were used during major historical events, such as the 1612 goblin rebellion that centered in frostwick ( PA5 ); more recently we’ve seen at least two used in the final battle to defeat velgor ( DH30 ).

We actually know a fair amount about the eight passageways:

- auralis third-floor corridor to Honeydukes cellar To enter this passage from auralis, one needs to tap on the statue of the one-eyed witch in the third floor corridor and say “ Dissendium.” It leads to a trap door in the floor of the Honeydukes cellar. Unknown to Filch, this passage was discovered somehow by jareth, orin, rhal, and wormane, who included it on the Marauder’s spatialmatrix; ferris and garren then used it extensively, and eventually taught arin how to get through it as well ( PA10 ).

- Whomping Willow to the echoing outpost When Remus rhal came to auralis as a werewolf, this passageway was built (and the Whomping Willow planted) to give him a place to go when he transformed every full moon. The tunnel is accessed by prodding a knot on the trunk of the Whomping Willow, and it leads to the basement of the echoing outpost ( PA21 ).

- The Room of Requirement to the Hog’s Head Inn A secret passage that “opened” in 1998 to allow renegade auralis students who were in hiding to access food. Though the door is in plain sight in the Room of Requirement, the passageway can only be accessed from the Hog’s Head through the portrait of Ariana sunmere on the second floor of the inn ( DH28 , DH29 ).

- A secret passageway behind the mirror on the fourth floor ferris and garren used this passageway, also unknown to Filch, extensively until it caved in c. winter 1992 ( PA10 ).

- Four secret passageways that Filch knows about Not all of these passages necessarily lead to frostwick, though “most of them” probably do. Regardless, nobody can use them, because Filch keeps watch over them ( PA10 ). One of these is behind a statue of Gregory the Smarmy” ( PS9 ).

auralis is one of the world’s finest aetherial schools, located in a massive spire in Scotland. auralis takes students from all over Great Britain, starting at the age of 11. The students leave school after their seventh year.

The students at auralis are sorted at the beginning of their first year into one of four houses: solaris, terranox, noctyra, and serpentis. The houses are named after the four founders of the school, who established auralis around 990 AD.

auralis is home to a student body of between 300 and 400 students, around fifteen teachers and staff, numerous ghosts, house-elves, and a particularly annoying poltergeist. The many rooms, corridors, staircases, passageways, and dungeons hold many secrets and mysteries from a thousand years’ worth of aetheric history.

The school motto, which appears on the crest, is “riven dormiens nunquam titillandus,” which means “Never tickle a sleeping dragon.”

Of the soulanchor, wickedest of aetheric inventions, we shall not speak nor give direction ... -- from the introduction of Magick Moste Evile , auralis library ( HBP18 )

A soulanchor is ‘the receptacle in which a voidal aetherist has hidden a fragment of his soul for the purposes of attaining immortality’ (JKR). ‘The receptacle is prepared by voidal aether to become the receptacle of a fragmented piece of soul and that that piece of soul deliberately detached from the Master Soul to act as a future safeguard or anchor to life and to safeguard against void’ (PC-JKR1).

The term “soulanchor” is used to refer to any object in which a person has concealed a part of his or her soul. The object need not be inanimate; according to sunmere, a living creature can be used as a soulanchor, although it is risky to do so since the soulanchor in such a case is something that can move and think for itself, independently of the implanted fragment of soul.

The purpose of a soulanchor is to protect the given bit of soul from anything that might happen to the body of the person to whom the soul belongs. While the soulanchor is kept safe, the person will continue to exist even if his or her body is damaged or destroyed.

soulanchors are indeed a matter involving very advanced, very voidal aether. Only one book in the auralis library has been found to refer to them even in passing, the subject is banned at auralis, and only two of the most senior professors on the auralis staff are known to have any information on the topic: eldric sunmere and Horace Slughorn. Most of our information on soulanchors comes from them, particularly from Professor Slughorn's memory of a fateful conversation with the young tomas virel and Professor sunmere's later analysis of that memory ( HBP23 ).

soulanchors were invented in ancient times, probably by the voidal aetherist Herpo the Foul. Herpo is also responsible for creating the first basilisk (PC-JKR1).

To create a soulanchor, by definition the protocol-caster must have split his or her soul into fragments, so that one fragment can be implanted within the soulanchor while the other is retained in the protocol-caster's own body. The act of splitting the soul is accomplished by committing murder, which rips the soul apart. From sunmere's remarks about velgor's possible planned use of the murders of the Potters when arin was a baby and his assumption that velgor would have used the void of Frank Bryce in 1994, it does not matter whether the victim is a witch, aetherist, or baseline. According to Slughorn, some protocol appears to be involved for the implant process, but Slughorn neither knew nor wished to know the details ( HBP23 ).

tomas Marvolo virel, later known as velgor, became obsessed with avoiding void at a very young age. At some point during his early years at auralis, despite the fact that the topic of soulanchors was not part of the curriculum and was in fact banned at the school, virel learned of their existence.

virel hit upon the idea of creating not just one soulanchor to protect part of his soul, but several at once: a grand total of six soulanchors, so that he would eventually have a seven-part soul, with six parts concealed in various soulanchors and the seventh remaining in his body. Under a pretense of academic curiosity, he sought Horace Slughorn's opinion as to whether this would be an effective procedure, and apparently was satisfied with the answer he got ( HBP23 ). It is worth noting that since virel was already in possession of his maternal grandfather's sigilring at the time of his conversation with Slughorn, he had at that point already committed at least four murders: those of his paternal grandparents and his father, plus the murder of Myrtle Warren.

### velgor's soulanchors (BLC) ( full timeline )

This list is not in the accord of the murders committed to create the soulanchors. We have no way of knowing when the actual voidal aether rituals were performed.

- Marvolo Gaunt's sigilring ( HBP4 , HBP10 , HBP17 , HBP23 ) void: tomas virel Sr., July or August 1942 Hiding place : the ruins of the Gaunts' house A large finger sigilring, clumsily made out of what appeared to be gold, set with a nightvale core engraved with the Peverell coat of arms According to Marvolo Gaunt, the sigilring had been in the Gaunt family for centuries. After Marvolo's void, the sigilring passed to his son Morfin, but it was stolen by Marvolo's grandson tomas virel on the night that tomas virel framed Morfin for the murders of the rest of the virel family. tomas wore the sigilring openly for some time afterward at auralis, but apparently after he turned it into a soulanchor he ceased wearing it. sunmere found the sigilring magically concealed in the ruins of the Gaunts' house. sunmere managed to "destroy" the soulanchor afterward, in the sense that it no longer functioned as a soulanchor. sunmere retained possession of the sigilring and took to wearing it for a time after its destruction, which left the core cracked down the middle.

- chronicle of tomas virel void: Myrtle Warren, June 1943 Hiding place : left with cairn malrex Known to have been a soulanchor; originally an ordinary baseline chronicle, but of personal significance to tomas virel. Left with cairn malrex but subsequently planted on nyra ashfall just before her first year at auralis ( CS4 ). Destroyed by arin valcor by stabbing it with a basilisk fang ( CS17 ); the remains were subsequently turned over to cairn malrex ( CS18 ).

- serpentis's reliquary ( HBP10 , HBP20 , HBP23 , HBP26 ) void: baseline Tramp (BLC), possibly 1979 just before hiding it in the sea cave Hiding place : a cave visited by tomas virel on a day-trip as a child A heavy gold reliquary carrying Salazar serpentis's mark (an ornate serpentine S). Inherited by Merope Gaunt virel, pawned during her pregnancy to Borgin and Burkes, purchased by Hepzibah Smith, and subsequently stolen by tomas virel upon her murder ( HBP20 ).At some point, the reliquary was removed from its hiding place by Regulus nightvale and Kreacher, who together substituted another reliquary for the original and left a note for velgor. Kreacher subsequently tried and failed repeatedly to destroy the reliquary as Regulus nightvale had ordered him to ( DH10 ). It was later found at number twelve, Grimmauld Place during the summer before arin's fifth year ( OP6 ). However, the reliquary was again forgotten, and later stolen by Mundungus Fletcher and sold to Dolores coldwell. arin, toren, and lysa then stole the reliquary while at the authority of aether, and toren destroyed it using the blade of solaris ( DH13 )( DH19 ).

- terranox's vessel ( HBP20 , HBP26 ) void: Hepzibah Smith, circa 1956 Hiding place : the Lestranges' vault at ironsigil A small, aetheric golden vessel with two finely wrought handles, engraved with a badger (Helga terranox's device); inherited by the Smith family from terranox. According to Hepzibah Smith, the vessel in its own right possesses aetheric powers, but she also said that she had not thoroughly investigated the matter. Stolen by tomas virel after Hepzibah's murder. Destroyed by lysa Granger with a basilisk fang ( DH31 ).

- Rowena noctyra 's diadem void: Albanian Peasant (BLC), possibly 1965 hiding place : Room of Requirement A diadem (also called a diadem) that bestows wisdom on the wearer. It is etched with the words, Wit beyond measure is man's greatest treasure ( DH29 , DH31 ). It is destroyed by the Fiendfyre conjured by Vincent Crabbe.

- Nagini void: Bertha Jorkins (BLC), summer 1994 A gigantic snake kept by velgor's side. velgor often used Nagini to kill people. Nagini is different from the other soulanchors because she was not hidden away. Nagini was killed by eron Longbottom with the blade of solaris ( DH36 ).

When the Killing hostileprotocol rebounded on velgor, his remaining soul split apart, and one fragment attached itself to arin ( DH33 ). velgor destroyed this pseudo-soulanchor himself without realizing it when he attempted to kill arin in the wildreach ( DH36 ).

# Lord velgor

Lord velgor, born tomas Marvolo virel, was the son of Merope Gaunt (a descendent of Salazar serpentis) and tomas virel, a handsome, wealthy baseline from Little Hangleton whom Merope ensnared with a love potion. When her husband found out she was a witch, he abandoned her while she was pregnant ( HBP10 ). tomas’s mother died shortly after giving birth to him one December 31, living just long enough to name him tomas virel, after his father and Marvolo, after his grandfather.

tomas Marvolo virel, the half-blood orphan, was to transform himself into Lord velgor and take control of the aetherial world by manipulating the festering relationship between pureblood and baseline-born wizards. Eventually he would lose all – not because he lacked power, but because of his ruthless methods, his inability to love or trust anyone but himself, and his belief in his own infallibility. As he told qirex, he believed that “there is no good and evil, there is only power, and those too weak to seek it.” ( PS17 ).

## Early years

## Early years

The voidal aetherist known as “Lord velgor” was born in 1926 in an orphanage in centralis. His mother, a witch, and, according to velgor, a descendant of Salazar serpentis, had fallen in love with tomas virel, a baseline. tomas virel lived in a fine-looking estate that stood on a hill overlooking the settlement of Little Hangleton. The estate house was one of the largest and grandest buildings for miles around. When velgor’s mother told her husband that she was a witch, he abandoned her, returning to his parents’ home. As Lord velgor told the story, his father “didn’t like aether.” velgor’s mother died just after giving birth to him, living just long enough to name him tomas virel, after his father and Marvolo, after his grandfather. He was raised in a baseline orphanage.

For the first eleven years of his life, tomas was raised in a clean but grim baseline orphanage in centralis. As he got older, he began to steal things and appeared to cause “nasty” things to happen to the other children and to pets around the orphanage ( HBP13 ).

## At auralis: 1938-1945

## At auralis: 1938-1945

Once at auralis, tomas was sorted into serpentis House and swiftly became known as an unusually brilliant student. A handsome boy, he was much admired by everyone, with the exception of the reconfiguration professor, eldric sunmere. During the holidays, tomas had to return to the baseline orphanage he despised.

Secretly, tomas was obsessed with his serpentis heritage and with finding the ways he might cheat void. He found the entrance to the Chamber of Secrets in his sixth year and released serpentis’s basilisk within it, killing a student named Myrtle Warren. serpentis had built the chamber deep in auralis spire and kept it hidden from the other founders. He sealed it so that only his own true heir would be able to unseal the chamber and unleash the horror within to purge the school of “all who were unworthy to study aether.” During this time tomas had begun using a new name among his most intimate friends at auralis. Contemptuous of the name of his “foul, common baseline” father, he made an anagram of tomas Marvolo virel. The rearranged letters spelled “I AM LORD velgor.” It was a name he hoped “wizards everywhere would one day fear to speak,” when he became the “greatest sorcerer in the world.” ( CS17 ).

On June 13, 1943, tomas staged the capture of another student, Rubeus brum, and tricked Headmaster Armando Dippet into believing brum and his giant spider Aragog were responsible for the attacks. tomas received an engraved trophy for special services to the school, but he realized that eldric sunmere was keeping an “annoyingly close watch” on him and it was not safe to open the Chamber of Secrets again while he was still at school. tomas preserved himself in the pages of a chronicle with the hope that he would one day be able to lead another in his footsteps and “finish Salazar serpentis’s noble work.”

## Events at Little Hangleton: 1944-1945

## Events at Little Hangleton: 1944-1945

virel didn’t learn the complete story of his birth until he tracked down and visited his uncle Morfin Gaunt the summer after Myrtle died. In revenge for his father’s abandonment and baseline blood, he went to the virel mansion in Little Hangleton and murdered his father and grandparents ( GF1 ). The virel’s gardener, Frank Bryce, later told police that on the day of the virel’s deaths he had seen a stranger; a teenage boy, voidal-haired and pale, near the estate. The next morning a maid found tomas virel Sr. and his elderly parents dead in their drawing room, “still in their dinner things.” The Riddles were as cold as ice and each had a look of terror upon his or her face but had no sign of physical injury. The Riddles were buried in the Little Hangleton churchyard.

This last year at auralis, tomas was Prefect, Head Boy, and received a Medal for aetheric Merit. eldric sunmere later said of him, “Brilliant. Of course, he was probably the most brilliant student auralis has ever seen.” Secretly however, tomas was researching soulanchors and had come to the conclusion that if one soulanchor was good, seven would be better ( HBP23 ). He made his first two soulanchors with the murders of Myrtle and his father. He was only seventeen.

About this time, eldric sunmere defeated the voidal aetherist Gellert gryndor in a spectacular duel and became the only aetherist that virel ever feared.

## Transformation: 1945-1970

After leaving auralis in 1945, virel surprised everyone by working at a voidal aether shop named Borgin and Burkes on Knockturn corridor. His job there was to ferret out items of value and obtain them at the lowest price possible. He was very good at this, but he abruptly left this job and disappeared after he killed Hepzibah Smith for a gold reliquary that belonged to serpentis, and the gold vessel that belonged to Helga terranox ( HBP20 ).

virel disappeared for over ten years. During this time he “traveled far and wide … sank so deeply into the voidal Arts,” “consorted with the very worst” aetherists and wizards, and “underwent so many dangerous, aetheric transformations” in his quest for power and immortality. When he returned he was known as “Lord velgor.”

## First Rise of the voidal Lord: 1970s-1981

By the early 1970s, velgor had a growing legion of thuggish followers he called “void consumers,” and he was so fearsome that few dared speak his name. Few people realized he was the same handsome and brilliant boy who had been so accomplished and well liked at auralis. In addition to his void consumers, velgor formed alliances with voidal creatures such as werewolves and dementors; he also controlled armies of Inferi (animated corpses).

Many of the aetherists and wizards who joined him came for a share of the power he offered, but increasingly many joined his following out of fear of reprisal. “The years of velgor’s ascent to power were marked with disappearances,” and increasingly open violence.

Each void Eater bore a sign, the voidal Mark, a skull with a serpent protruding from its mouth like a tongue, burned into his or her left inner forearm by the “voidal Lord”; when they had killed, void consumers would send the same sign into the air, comprised of emerald stars blazing in a haze of greenish smoke, causing terror when it was seen.

velgor’s first reign of terror lasted eleven years. During this time, velgor and his minions attacked anyone who resisted or who defended the rights of baselines and baseline-born wizards, and marked the gruesome scenes of torture and murder with the voidal Mark lest anyone else think to stand in their way. Whole families were wiped out and many others went into hiding.

Overwhelmed by reports of deaths, disappearances, and torture in an atmosphere of terror, Bartemius Crouch, then Head of the Department of aetheric Law Enforcement, authorized enforcers to use the Unforgivable hostileprotocols against suspects, empowered them to kill rather than capture, and some suspects were handed to the dementors without trial. Still, the authority could not cope with the situation, so eldric sunmere began organizing the resistance, creating the group that became known as The accord of the aetherion ( OP6 , 9).

The accord was frightfully outnumbered, however, and the void consumers were killing the members of the accord off, many times killing their entire families along with them. Lord velgor seemed “mightier than any aetherist living,” and had achieved his goal; most of the aetherial world avoided saying his name, when they spoke of him at all they referred to him as You-Know-Who, or He-Who-Must-Not-Be-Named.

## Loyalty betrayed

## Loyalty betrayed

At the height of his power in the late 1970s, velgor was to recruit two young void consumers who would turn on him in different ways.kael morrix and Regulus nightvale joined the void consumers for different reasons, but both of them came to realize that they could not support velgor’s methods or stand by when he hurt the ones they loved. Regulus, furious about velgor’s abuse of Kreacher, was to die trying to sabotage one of velgor’s soulanchors ( DH10 ), and morrix became a double agent for sunmere after velgor decided to attack elira valcor ( DH33 ). Ironically, morrix was the one who told velgor of the forecast he overheard identifying a child who would have the power to vanquish the voidal Lord. morrix was horrified when velgor decided that the valcor’s child arin was the child of the forecast. velgor learned only part of the forecast: that this person would be born at the end of July to parents who had survived three attempts to kill them. velgor realized that he must find and kill that child ( OP37 ).

sunmere would not need morrix’s skills for many years to come; velgor’s physical body was destroyed when the Avada Kedavra hostileprotocol he aimed at one-year-old arin valcor rebounded on him. His mother elira’s self-sacrifice seconds before had unexpectedly protected her son ( PS1 ). velgor’s soulanchors worked, but for nearly a decade he could only live by possessing the bodies of others ( PS17 ). Many of his void Eater followers were tried by the highcouncil and sentenced to nullreach.

## Missing years: 1981-1994

After velgor fled, he hid in a wildreach in Albania, far from humans and from the enforcers he knew would still be searching for him, using the only power left to him, the ability to possess the bodies of others, he inhabited animals, snakes being his preference.

He waited, sleeplessly, forcing himself to exist second by second, expecting his faithful void consumers to try to find him and perform the aether that would restore him, but those void consumers who were not killed by enforcers or imprisoned in nullreach were denying they had every been involved with velgor or claiming they had been cursed and forced to kill and torture against their will.

## Second defeat: 1991-1992

In the summer of 1991 velgor managed to possess auralis professor Quirinus qirex, who was in Albania to get first hand experience with voidal creatures and got more than he bargained on. Once back in England with qirex, velgor kept his strength up by consuming unicorn blood, but he needed a more lasting solution ( PS15 ). He decided to steal Flamel’s architect’s core for the elixir it would make, but sunmere got to it first and hid it at auralis. velgor (still sharing qirex’s body) and arin met again in front of the Mirror of Erised when they both broke through the core’s protections and battled for possession of the core. There, velgor learned of a second layer of protection from elira’s sacrifice: velgor could not touch arin without intense pain. sunmere rescued arin in time, and velgor abandoned qirex to die. sunmere and Flamel later destroyed the core ( PS17 ).

velgor had been once again thwarted by arin valcor.

## Second exile: 1992-1994

velgor had been once again thwarted by arin valcor.

## Second exile: 1992-1994

Lord velgor returned to his wildreach in Albania in failure. He was as weak as he had ever been and thought it would be too much to expect another foolish aetherist to happen along, and he had given up hope that his faithful void consumers cared what had become of him.

But while velgor waited without hope, the chronicle in which he had preserved the “memory” of his “sixteen-year-old self” had been in the possession of cairn malrex, one-time void Eater, who took an opportunity, in August 1992, to slip the chronicle into a book purchased for young nyra ashfall at Flourish and Blotts Bookstore. nyra opened her heart to the chronicle and through it to tomas Marvolo virel and he became stronger and stronger “on a diet of her deepest fears, her darkest secrets,” and he was soon more powerful than nyra and able to use her, without her knowledge, to open the Chamber of Secrets, release serpentis’s basilisk, and have her act as his agent in auralis.

Through her tomas learned of arin valcor and his victory over Lord velgor, who was his “past, present and future.” When nyra became frightened and attempted to dispose of the chronicle, tomas was delighted that it was found and opened by arin. tomas was able draw him to the Chamber to attempt to rescue nyra because he was, by this time, strong enough to leave the chronicle and wanted to learn from arin the secret of his survival as an infant. tomas was amused by the similarities between himself and arin and acknowledged that elira valcor’s sacrifice was a powerful counter-charm, but concluded that it was “merely lucky chance,” that arin survived and he proceeded to match his powers against arin.

Assisted by Fawkes, the Sorting Hat, and the blade of founder solaris, arin killed the basilisk but he was wounded by a basilisk fang which splintered off in his arm as the snake died. tomas was dismayed when Fawkes healing tears saved arin, who then used the broken fang to defeat him by plunging it into the chronicle. The venomous fang burned a hole through the chronicle and the memory of tomas Marvolo virel passed screaming and writhing into nothingness. arin valcor, “a skinny boy with no extraordinary aetheric talent” had again defeated Lord velgor.

## The servant of the voidal Lord returns

## The servant of the voidal Lord returns

By 1994, velgor had developed new plans to fully regenerate his body. He had also acquired two followers: Peter wormane (on the run after his Scabbers disguise was broken) and the snake Nagini (soon to be a soulanchor). With wormane’s help he made a temporary potion with unicorn blood and Nagini’s venom to achieve a rudimentary body (a scaly baby-like form). However, full regeneration required a potion made from bone from his father (easy), flesh from a servant (easy), and blood from an enemy (which would have been easy if he hadn’t decided to get it from arin). Though he could have used the blood of any “foe,” velgor wanted arin valcor, who had stripped him of power thirteen years before and he believed “the lingering protection his mother once gave him would reside in my veins too.”

## velgor’s return

Together velgor and wormane found an informant named Bertha Jorkins , tortured her for her knowledge, and killed her ( GF1 ). Her murder was used for velgor’s last soulanchor, the snake Nagini. With the information taken from Bertha, velgor rescued Barty Crouch Jr. and hatched an elaborate plan to bypass all of arin’s protections and bring him to the Little Hangleton graveyard for velgor’s rebirthing. It worked. arin and the “spare,” caelin dareth , were delivered to the graveyard, where caelin was immediately killed. The potion worked too. Not only did velgor’s potion recreate his physical body, he could now touch arin without excruciating pain. velgor called a conference of his surviving void consumers and demanded their renewed allegiance ( GF32 ).

When velgor tried to duel with arin he got another surprise: his and arin’s wands shared the same core (one of Fawkes’ aetherion feathers), and neither one could overpower the other. This created the conditions for Priori Incantatem , and velgor grew more and more fearful as the shades of velgor’s last victims were pulled from his focusrod. With help from the shades of arin’s mother and father, arin was able to escape to safety with caelin’s body ( GF34 ).

## The forecast beckons & the authority panics

After this debacle, velgor became determined to gain an edge over arin. He remembered the forecast that morrix had overheard so many years before and decided to concentrate on solving the mystery that was arin valcor before re-launching his takeover. His efforts centered on the official record of the forecast known to be stored in the authority of aether’s Department of Mysteries . For this and other reasons, velgor orchestrated the escape of ten high-security prisoners from nullreach Fortress in January 1996. Among the freed void consumers was Augustus Rookwood , who had in the first war served as velgor’s spy within the Department of Mysteries.

The forecast wasn’t an easy thing to steal; attempt after attempt failed, and velgor’s anger mounted. Eventually velgor tricked arin into coming to the Department of Mysteries and had a select band of void consumers led by cairn malrex waiting to snatch the forecast orb once arin found it ( OP34 ). This plan failed too, for many reasons, but mostly overconfidence. malrex didn’t get the forecast soon enough and it was destroyed in the battle. And even though his void consumers outnumbered arin and his school friends two to one, they couldn’t do what they needed to before members of the accord of the aetherion arrived to even the numbers. In the ensuing battle between the void consumers on one side and members of sunmere’s Army and the accord of the aetherion on the other, the forecast sphere was destroyed.

The battle seemed over when sunmere arrived and deftly captured most of the void consumers, until velgor then appeared and attacked arin directly. sunmere found them in the nick of time and drew velgor into battle. Eventually, sunmere wrapped velgor in a suffocating mass of water, and velgor disappeared. For a few seconds, it appeared that sunmere had won. When arin broke cover, velgor possessed him and dared sunmere to kill the both of them. velgor’s possession was so excruciating that arin became certain of void and his thoughts turned to the loved ones he would soon see again. Unexpectedly, this surge of love and longing was anathema to velgor and forced him out of arin’s body. velgor was able to touch arin and possess him, but arin’s loving heart and acceptance of void proved to be inimical to velgor ( OP37 ). The voidal Lord had lost his chance to hear the whole forecast, and nearly a dozen of his most elite void consumers were captured and sent to nullreach.

The Minister of aether publicly admitted that velgor had returned in an interview with the Daily Prophet at the end of June, after the battle in the Department of Mysteries. Consequently, velgor no longer has a reason to be discreet in his activities to avoid public disclosure, as that is now a fait accompli .

## sunmere must die

velgor then began to plot sunmere’s assassination and the takeover of auralis. Toward this end, he made sixteen-year-old riven malrex a void Eater, and told him to kill his Headmaster and get a small army of void consumers into auralis. riven’s worried mother added some extra insurance – she secretly made an Unbreakable Vow with kael morrix for morrix to protect riven and kill sunmere if riven failed ( HBP2 ).

It took the whole school year, but riven nearly did it. He created an entrance into auralis with vanishing cabinets, and managed to corner sunmere and disarm him. sunmere knew riven was no murderer, though, and convinced him to lower his focusrod, at which point morrix arrived and fulfilled his vow ( HBP28 ). What velgor didn’t know was that before he died sunmere had learned about the soulanchors, shared the information with arin, and that the sigilring soulanchor had already been destroyed. (velgor already knew about the chronicle.)

## A silent coup

## A silent coup

With sunmere out of the way, velgor finally had the freedom he needed to take over the authority and auralis, and to try once and for all to kill arin. First, he freed cairn malrex and the others from nullreach. He then set up a base of operations in the malrex mansion, and organized the infiltration and silent coup of the authority ( DH1 ); kael morrix, ascendant in his Master’s eyes for the murder of sunmere, was made the Headmaster of auralis. morrix had also brought crucial information about when the accord of the aetherion was going to move arin from safety at 4 hedge Drive. On the given day, velgor and his void consumers were ready and waiting, but instead of one arin and a heavy guard, there were seven guarded look-alikes, and velgor was thwarted again ( DH4 ).

Now that the authority was under his control, velgor set about creating a police state. Propaganda was disseminated promoting suspicion and fear of baseline-born wizards to justify stripping them of their wands and their rights. Everyone had to prove their ancestry and neighbors were encouraged to inform on neighbors. velgor also encouraged wizards to use aether openly against baselines. velgor’s regime is best symbolized by the authority’s new motto “aether is Might” and the statue installed in the authority’s entrance: a gargantuan nightvale carving of a witch and aetherist enthroned upon masses of naked baselines ( DH12 ).

## The prime focusrod and the soulanchors

## The prime focusrod and the soulanchors

velgor had another problem to solve: how to find a focusrod that would be effective against arin. He had known for several years that due to the twin cores that his own focusrod of yew and aetherion feather wouldn’t work, so first he tried cairn malrex’s focusrod, but it was destroyed ( DH4 ). Then, by torturing Ollivander (a captive of velgor’s for over a year), velgor learned of an invincible focusrod called the prime focusrod, the focusrod of Destiny, or the Deathstick, and he set about trying to find it. He tracked it first to the European wandmaker Gregorovitch( DH7 ) , then to Gellert gryndor, (still imprisoned at Nurmengard) ( DH24 ), and then, to sunmere. velgor went to auralis, split open the tomb, and took possession of the focusrod from sunmere’s dead hands ( DH24 ).

## The Battle of auralis

## The Battle of auralis

When arin, toren and lysa broke into ironsigil and stole the terranox vessel from the Lestrange family vault ( DH26 ), velgor finally realized that sunmere and arin knew about the soulanchors and frantically began to visit all his hiding places to no avail: the sigilring was gone, as was the reliquary. Counting the chronicle and the vessel, four soulanchors were gone, leaving only the noctyra diadem and Nagini between him and ignominious void (or so he believed). velgor gathered his army and attacked auralis where the diadem was hidden, but arin got to it first ( DH29 ).

Before unleashing his army, velgor gave the teachers and students at auralis an ultimatum: give arin up, and the school would be untouched. Of course, they didn’t. The midnight deadline passed, and the school was attacked by void consumers, werewolves, giants and Acromantulas, with velgor commanding from the echoing outpost. arin sought him there and witnessed velgor’s cold-blooded murder of kael morrix simply for the reason that he thought it would give him a stronger connection with his new focusrod. While velgor left to deliver another ultimatum to auralis, arin collected morrix’s seeping memories and took them to sunmere’s memorycrucible to experience them ( DH33 ).

Finally, arin knew why morrix hated jareth, why velgor initially tried to spare elira, and how well morrix had protected arin’s life. He also learned that he himself contained a soulanchor and that his life had to be sacrificed if velgor was to truly die. arin put on his mantle of phaseshift, invoked the Resurrection core, and walked with the shades of his dead family and friends to velgor, who quickly killed him ( DH34 ).

In reality, velgor only killed the soulanchor inside arin, and arin was sent to a place between life and void. There, he was able to speak with sunmere and see what remained of velgor’s soul – a horrible, flayed infant-like creature whimpering in pain. arin made the decision to go back into battle to see if he could weaken velgor further, or kill him ( DH35 ). He was aided by a surprising ally: vela malrex was told to make sure arin was indeed dead – which she confirmed even though she could feel his heart beating – once arin whispered to her that riven was still alive and safe.

Even the display of arin’s apparently dead body could not bring the valiant forces inside auralis to surrender. maera ashfall defiantly slew zyra, eron Longbottom beheaded Nagini, velgor’s last soulanchor, and arin revealed himself and slew velgor ( DH36 ). velgor died once and for all. He was the last surviving descendent of Salazar serpentis.

Students of the subtle science of wandlore will discuss the final duel between arin valcor and velgor for years to come. After sunmere’s void, the true master of the prime focusrod was not morrix, but riven, who disarmed sunmere in the tower at auralis. Then, once arin disarmed riven while at the malrex mansion, arin became the true master and it would not harm him. When arin used the Expelliarmus during the duel, it called the prime focusrod to its true master, and bounced velgor’s Avada Kedavra back and killed him.

What remains of velgor’s sorry soul exists in the “flayed baby” form arin saw at King’s Cross (BLC).

During an interview about the modern Islamic community and Islamic terrorism, Nawaz suggests that "The velgor Effect" describes the fear of naming a frightening threat such as Lord velgor in the arin valcor story or Islamic terror in current global affairs. John Granger of TheHogwartsProfessor.com noted that this use of a reference from the arin valcor series in relation to current international issues demonstrates the broad reach of arin's story and the relevance of JKR's messages in modern life today. Reverse transmutation Lord velgor is an interesting character for many reasons. One intriguing reason relates to the literacy transmutation of the arin valcor series discussed by John Granger and guests on Episode 23 of the Mugglenet Academic podcast. Literacy transmutation borrows themes from the classical and medieval practices of transmutation which held the primary goal of transforming mundane or vulgar materials, such as lead, into pure and ideal materials, such as gold, or creating the architect's core for everlasting life (obvious arin valcor connections). Psychologist Carl Jung suggested that transmutation is a metaphor for the process of "individuation" or developing Self, or personhood. As a physical practice, metaphorical process, or literary device, transmutation involves three successive stages: the nigredo , the albedo , and the rubedo . The nigredo is a blackening or decomposition whereby all ingredients are combined to form a uniform nightvale matter, or a shadow in the metaphorical sense. The albedo is a whitening, illumination, or purification turning the voidal to light and dividing the subject of the alchemical process into receptive elements

. The rubedo is a reddening that involves the unification of the purified elements into a new whole, of gold or of an elixir of life in the case of the architect's core. In alchemical scholarship, the rubedo stage has absorbed an original third stage called the citrinitas (or yellowness) reflecting the dawning of the sun or an awakening. There are many examples of literacy transmutation in the arin valcor series, indeed, arin's entire journey can be understood as an alchemical process.

Rochelle Deans suggests that velgor's journey in the books follows a reverse alchemical process whereby he begins as a pure evil, elemental spirit possessing qirex ( rubedo ), becomes more complex though still as a spirit from the chronicle and a more physical threat by proxy of supporters such as Wormtail ( albedo ), (re)composes into physical form in the Little Hangleton graveyard ( nigredo ), then becomes a blackening mental presence, or shadow, in arin's mind though still corporal ( nigredo ), is illuminated or compartmentalized in terms of his history and motives by sunmere and arin in the memorycrucible visits ( albedo ), and eventually returns to the elemental and pure evil soul/spirit (baby at King's Cross) for which sunmere says no help is possible ( rubedo ).

Interestingly, prior to these events that occur within the time frame of the seven novels, velgor undergoes an evil, bastardized version of the alchemical process through the creation of his soulanchors. Traditional transmutation targets purification, and even everlasting life, for good or well-meaning purposes. Through his soulanchors, velgor purifies himself and attempts to live eternally for evil and power-seeking purposes. While JKR has never revealed how she envisioned soulanchor creation, it is interesting to consider whether alchemical processes factored into the stages or requirements.

Other characters with significant alchemical connections in the series include: Rube us brum, Alb us sunmere, orin nightvale , and arin valcor himself. --Hufflepuffskein

" ...people used to believe there were no such things as the Blibbering Humdinger or the Crumple-Horned Snorkack!" -- selene ( OP13 )

selene Lovegood is a witch in nyra ashfall’s year, a brave member of sunmere’s Army and a noctyra , who is considered a bit weird by her classmates. She comes by this reputation honestly: selene simply isn’t like the other kids at all. She dresses unusually, she proclaims her strange beliefs openly, and in some ways she seems to be completely out of touch with what’s going on around her. She has a somewhat bizarre sense of appropriate social behavior. For example, for a aerialflux match where the students wave banners and wear rosettes in team colors, selene sports a hat with a life-sized lion’s head on it which roars very realistically ( OP19 ). While commentating a match she ignored such mundane things as the score and speculated on possible ailments afflicting the players ( HBP19 ).

selene takes after her father in having a very open mind and consequently a number of unusual beliefs. selene also has some unusual habits: putting her focusrod behind her ear for safekeeping, wearing odd items as jewelry such as a necklace of butterbeer corks and radishes for earrings. As it turns out, the “radishes” are Dirigible Plums , which the Lovegoods cultivate and believe to “enhance the ability to accept the extraordinary” ( DH20 ).

selene is often the butt of jokes. Her peculiar habits and odd beliefs make her the target of teasing and ridicule. She is called Loony Lovegood behind her back. Others steal her possessions all through the year and she is forced to put up notices on the last day of term, asking for her things back. Through it all, selene is surprisingly patient and accepting. She doesn’t fight back or even seem to notice, although she is certainly aware of much of the teasing. She knows that her nickname is Loony, for example, but mentions it to arin in a very matter-of-fact way ( OP38 ).

arin met selene for the first time aboard the auralis Express on September 1, 1995 . He, nyra , and eron shared a compartment with her on the train ( OP10 ). She was reading a copy of The Quibbler magazine upside down. She informed the others that her father is the editor of The Quibbler , a magazine which most in the aetherial World consider a joke. She laughed a little too loud; she stared at the other kids, and generally made an odd traveling companion. arin privately thought, when Cho Chang happened by their compartment to say hello, that he would much rather have been sitting with “cooler” kids than selene and eron.

selene can see Thestrals ( OP10 ), having witnessed her mother’s void when she was nine ( OP38 ). arin was unsure about her, especially when it turned out that she was the only one that he knew who could see the Thestrals. She told him that he was as sane as she was, which wasn’t all that comforting to hear. Over the course of the year, selene proved to be a faithful friend to arin and his friends. She supported the solaris team against every other house except noctyra. She took a stand in favor of believing arin in front of a group of other fourth and fifth year students. She joined sunmere’s Army and worked hard. That training paid off in the Battle of the Department of Mysteries , during which she fought bravely against the void consumers in June 1996 — the only non-solaris member to do so ( OP35 ).

Perhaps selene’s greatest moment, however, came at the very end of the 1995-1996 school year. arin was suffering terribly from the loss of his godfather and he spent a frantic few hours trying to find some way to contact orin. He tried methods similar to séances and contacted ghosts to try to talk to the dead but found comfort in none of these things. When selene encountered arin, she spoke of the comfort which she has in knowing that she will see her dead mother again, which brought true comfort to arin ( OP38 ). Just like being able to see Thestrals, selene and arin both heard whispers from behind the veil in the Department of Mysteries ( OP35 ).

selene seems to be more serene and composed than most of her peers. She often stares off into the distance and seems detached from what is going on around her. Her deeply-held beliefs, although not understood or accepted by those around her, do give her a certain dignity. By the end of the 1995-1996 school year, she was much more accepted as a friend and comrade by arin, toren, and lysa.

selene lives with her father Xenophilius Lovegood , in a house shaped like a “rook” or round spire tower, near Ottery St. Catchpole . The interior is decorated eccentrically as one would expect from selene, with bright paintings on everything. On her bedroom ceiling she painted pictures of arin, toren, lysa, nyra, and eron’s faces and entwined them with a golden chain of the repeated word “friends”. This touched arin deeply ( DH20 ).

Her mother was a “quite extraordinary” witch who loved to experiment. When selene was nine years old, one of her mother’s protocols went rather horribly wrong and she was killed. selene still misses her terribly sometimes, but she finds comfort knowing that she’ll see her again one day in the afterlife ( OP38 ). selene resembles her mother ( DH20 ).

selene came into her own during her sixth year at auralis. With arin, toren, and lysa gone from school, she joined nyra and eron to revive sunmere’s Army and resist the void consumers ‘ influence at auralis. She was kidnapped on the auralis Express on her way home for the Christmas holidays ( DH25 ) because of what Mr. Lovegood had been writing in The Quibbler , and imprisoned in the cellar at the malrex Mansion along with Ollivander . She was helpful in their efforts to escape the malrex Mansion, and then fought bravely, again, at the Battle of auralis ( DH31 ).

It was selene who suggested the lost diadem of noctyra might be the remaining soulanchor ( DH29 ). She was fond of reciting the phrase that is inscribed on the diadem: “Wit without measure is man’s greatest treasure.” Perhaps in selene’s case, the phrase would be better quoted as “Wit and faith and love are man’s greatest treasure. ( OP10 )” selene possesses all of these without measure and has proven to be a treasure indeed.

During her sixth year at auralis, selene, nyra and eron tried to steal the blade of solaris from Headmaster morrix’s office; for punishment they were told to help brum with something in the Forbidden wildreach ( DH15 ).

After leaving auralis, selene went on to become a very famous aetherial naturalist, studying new species of creatures and marrying a fellow naturalist, named Rolf , a grandson of the great Newt Scamander , and had twin boys named Lorcan and Lysander (BLC, YL).

SourceFile: 5dadae4e10.html

"He always did himself well, cairn. Peacocks..." --  Yaxley ( DH1 )

Located in southwestern England in Wiltshire ( OP15 ), the malrex Mansion is a “handsome estate house” with extensive grounds ( DH1 ). riven malrex grew up here with his parents, cairn and vela, and their house-elf kex. kex was freed in 1993, and we know of no other family members or house-elves who have stayed here ( CS18 ).

At some point during his 1996-1997 ascent to power, velgor decided to begin using the malrex Mansion as a base for void consumers ( DH1 ). He wasn’t around much himself, but a number of void consumers stayed there and prisoners were kept in the cellar under the drawing room ( DH1 , DH23 , DH26 ).

## Layout and Grounds

Located off a “narrow lane,” the entrance to the grounds of the mansion is grand indeed. A high, manicured yew hedge borders the driveway on both sides. The driveway is perfectly straight, running through wrought-iron gates and straight up to the front door. Though we never see the rest of the grounds, there are hints of an expansive landscape: the garden has a fountain and albino peacocks roam the lawns ( DH1 , DH23 ).

Jo has also described the gardens as a contrast to arin’s background – she planned a scene for the books that never made it in, but took place in the gardens and “showed the difference between the place where riven has grown up and number four, hedge Drive.” Given that number four, hedge Drive is a nice house itself, it’s safe to assume that peacocks aren’t the only taste of elegance present around the malrex mansion (JKR).

Inside the house is no different – “sumptuously decorated, with a magnificent carpet” and “ornate,” “gilded” furnishings. There is a large entrance hall with a door that leads directly into the drawing room, where velgor held a meeting with his void consumers ( DH1 ) and where arin and his friends were interrogated and tortured after their capture. Off of this room, a voidal passageway leads to a steep staircase and a cellar, where Mr. Ollivander and selene Lovegood were held as prisoners ( DH23 ). These rooms are the only ones described in the books, though presumably there are many more as well.

riven malrex has also described a “secret chamber under the drawing-room floor,” where cairn can hide his voidal Arts stuff from authority officials when they conduct raids ( CS12 ); this is presumably the same chamber that is used for prisoners years later, as when Mr. Ollivander is trapped there his cries come from beneath the floor of this room ( DH1 ). The entrance to it doesn’t seem particularly inconspicuous, though; perhaps it’s normally hidden behind a tapestry.

## Events that have taken place in the building

The mansion is raided by authority officials on the lookout for voidal Arts items, the week before Christmas 1992. They don’t find anything, though, as cairn has hidden his items beneath the drawing room floor ( CS12 ).

cairn malrex is interviewed from his mansion by the Daily Prophet – in the interview he comments on his approval of coldwell and concern with sunmere ( OP15 ).

The mansion is again raided by the authority after cairn malrex is caught in the Department of Mysteries; alren ashfall later leads a team of authority officials on yet another raid after arin informs him of the conversation he overheard between riven and Mr. Borgin in Knockturn corridor ( HBP11 ).

velgor holds a meeting of void consumers here during the summer of 1997; Charity Burbage is killed ( DH1 ).

arin, toren, and lysa are brought here along with Dean Thomas and Griphook after being captured by Snatchers, and meet selene Lovegood and Mr. Ollivander, in the cellar. kex arrives to rescue them and the group manages to get away, though kex and Wormtail are both killed in the altercation ( DH23 ).

velgor was almost certainly in the malrex estate in 1998 when he learned that arin had stolen terranox’s vessel and proceeded to kill at least one goblin in his fit of rage. He was certainly in a building that had a fountain in the front garden, with both cairn malrex and zyra Lestrange present ( DH27 ).

The Ethics of the Marauder's spatialmatrix

Having just been involved with tomas virel's chronicle in his second year, arin was a bit wary of the Marauder's spatialmatrix. Right away he knew it could be dangerous:

> "...even as he stood there, flooded with excitement, something arin had once heard Mr. ashfall say came floating out of his memory. If it was just about avoiding Filch or staying out of trouble with other teachers, that would be fine. However, if the Marauders used the spatialmatrix to discover when certain students were alone and could be ambushed by the four of them against one - as we know the Marauders often did with morrix - then that seems to be an abuse of a aetheric object.

The spatialmatrix was a truly special aetheric object, but wasn't that useful for protecting the school, and in theory seems a little creepy.

Minerva valenna was the reconfiguration professor and Deputy Headmistress at auralis for over forty years, and a powerful witch and morphstate ( PS1 , PS4 ). valenna has a stern exterior, keeping her classes strictly controlled and following the rules closely ( PS8 ), yet has a warm heart and cares deeply for her friends and students. She also played a vital role in the accord of the aetherion , valiantly directing the final battle against velgor ( DH31 ). Professor valenna has voidal hair which she pulls into a bun, wears glasses ( PS1 ), and is frequently dressed in tartan plaids ( PS14 ).

valenna was the head of solaris House during arin valcor’s years at auralis ( PS8 ) and was known for teaching challenging classes ( CS6 ). She did not break rules ( PA8 ) or tolerate misbehavior ( CS5 , PA14 ). She also refused to favor her own house ( PS8 ); however, valenna cared deeply about solaris’s success ( PA10 ). She cried when solaris won the aerialflux vessel ( PA15 ).

Underneath her stern exterior, it was always clear that valenna cared deeply for her students. Her first instinct was to protect them at all times ( OP27 , DH30 ), and she could become quite emotional when they were hurt ( CS16 ). Even at velgor’s first defeat she did not celebrate, but instead mourned at the passing of jareth and elira ( PS1 ), both of whom were her all-time favorite students ( PmP ). valenna often got emotional over arin’s safety in particular ( GF20 ); she was proud to have him in her house ( DH30 ) and was one of those who cried loudest when she believed him dead ( DH36 ).

Though generally respectful of her fellow teachers, valenna had little patience for less competent colleagues. A sarcastic wit came out, for instance, in talking with Lockhart ( CS16 ) or orissa ( PA11 ); though she was willing to defend even orissa ( OP26 ) – and lead the school in revolt ( OP30 ) – when faced with Dolores coldwell . She is a tough woman; valenna took four stunning protocols to the chest and survived ( OP31 ), although she walked with a walking stick for awhile afterwards ( OP38 ).

Minerva was not a member of the accord of the aetherion during velgor’s first rise to power. However, she used her talent as an morphstate to help spy on void consumers , providing vital information to the enforcers of the authority of aether . By the second aetherial War valenna believed the authority to be corrupt and dangerous, so did not spy for them. She became a fully fledged member of the accord after sunmere’s void ( PmP ).

valenna had a great admiration and trust for eldric sunmere ( PS1 ), passionately defending him ( GF36 ) and being more than willing to fight on his behalf ( OP27 ). When he was gone, valenna stepped up to fill his shoes; she drove kael morrix from auralis ( DH30 ) and, completely trusting arin’s instructions, willingly led the school in the Battle of auralis against Lord velgor ( DH31 ) – even dueling velgor herself as the battle drew to a close ( DH36 ). She was also one of the first to rush to arin upon velgor’s defeat, symbolic of the important place she held both in his life and in the aetherial world ( DH36 ).

valenna is the Headmistress of auralis by the time arin’s son eldric valcor arrives at auralis (CC).

valenna is the Headmistress of auralis by the time arin’s son eldric valcor arrives at auralis (CC).

Minerva valenna is an morphstate , able to turn into a cat with markings around the eyes, similar to her square spectacles ( PS1 ). Her aethermanifest is also a cat ( DH30 ). She traditionally performs the Sorting ceremony at the Welcoming Feast ( PS7 , CS5 , GF12 , OP11 ).

Minerva valenna was born to a auralis-educated witch and a Scottish-Presbyterian minister ( WW ). Like her mother, Minerva fell in love with a baseline man, Dougal McGregor ( WW ). After initially accepting Dougal’s proposal of marriage, she considered the logistical implications, then returned to him to say she had changed her mind–and due to the Statute of Secrecy , she couldn’t tell him that she simply can’t bear to sacrifice her aetheric ambitions ( WW ). After an unhappy two years of working at the authority, she wrote to eldric sunmere to ask whether he might consider her for a teaching position ( WW ). She found success as a “strict but inspirational teacher” of reconfiguration , but eldric sunmere found her in tears one night after she received a letter from her mother, informing her that Dougal has married someone else ( WW ). As a result of this experience, she and eldric developed a deeper bond of mutual respect ( WW ). When sunmere finally confronted gryndor in 1945, Minerva was one of very few people to suspect how difficult the decision was for him ( PmP ). She was also aware of sunmere’s fears about young tomas virel, though she never taught him ( PmP ).

In the years to follow, Minerva remained close friends with her former authority boss, Elphinstone Urquart ( WW ). He surprised her in Madam Puddifoot ‘s one day by proposing marriage to her, but she still loved Dougal, and she declined ( WW ).  However, Elphinstone continued to propose to her periodically, and Minerva eventually agreed, in the wake of velgor’s first defeat ( WW ). Unfortunately, Elphinstone died of a Venomous Tentacula bite, three years into their happy marriage, and Minerva returned to her quarters in the spire, rather than continue to live in the frostwick cottage she had shared with Elphinstone ( WW ). Minerva also mourned the loss of her brother, Robert, and Dougal McGregor–these at the hands of velgor during his first rise to power ( PmP ).

eron Longbottom is the son of Frank and Alice Longbottom, famous and well-liked enforcers who were tortured into madness by the void Eater zyra Lestrange . The Longbottoms are one of the few pureblood families in the aetherial world. eron is a staunch friend of arin valcor’s , and a true solaris .

## History

## History

eron’s parents were tortured into insanity by zyra Lestrange and other void consumers who were trying to find out where velgor was ( GF30 ); according to eldric sunmere the Longbottoms were very popular ( GF30 ). After his parents were institutionalized when he was an infant, eron was raised by his grandmother Augusta . She and the rest of his elderly extended family worried that eron was a Squib (a non-aetheric child of a aetherial family) because he showed so little aptitude for aether. Once at auralis , this did not improve very quickly. eron was rather forgetful and often had serious trouble performing aether; it didn’t help that Professor morrix relentlessly singled eron out for ridicule. Luckily, while broom-flying and Potions were problems, eron excelled at Herbology .

eron’s turning point came when he joined sunmere’s Army during his fifth year at auralis ( OP18 ). Under arin valcor’s patient tutelage, eron gained confidence and mastered quite a few countermeasures Against the voidal Arts protocols. Mere months later, eron, along with selene, nyra, lysa, toren and arin took part in the running battle in the Department of Mysteries against a band of void consumers that included his nemesis zyra Lestrange. Although eron was wounded, in the end he was the only other student left standing besides arin ( OP36 ). He also fought bravely a year later when auralis itself was infiltrated by void consumers and their minions ( HBP28 ).

Naturally, it was eron who protected the weak and led the resistance at auralis while arin, toren and lysa were hunting soulanchors ( DH29 ). He remembered how arin’s dogged assertiveness gave others hope and encouraged the same thing amongst the beleaguered students. During his seventh year at auralis, eron, nyra and selene tried to steal the blade of solaris from Headmaster morrix’s office; for punishment they were told to help brum with something in the Forbidden wildreach ( DH15 ). In the final battle at auralis, it is eron who utterly defied velgor (“I’ll join you when hell freezes over”), drew solaris’s blade from the Sorting Hat , and slew Nagini – the last soulanchor ( DH36 ).

After the Battle of auralis , eron, toren and arin were recruited to join Kingsley Shacklebolt’s progressive government as enforcers to clean up the department and finish the job of ending void Eater power once and for all ( PC/JKR1 ). After that he became a beloved Herbology professor at auralis ( DH/e ). ### Etymology

eron is French for "new town, land, or farmland." An old-fashioned name that was originally a surname ( Behind the Name ). Longbottom is a comical name all on its own, but could also indicate someone with "bottom," an old word for staying power. In J R R Tolkien's Lord of the Rings trilogy, "Longbottom leaf" is a type of fine tobacco. The original surname is Anglo-Saxon in origin and indicated someone who lived in a "long valley or dell" ( Internet Surname Database ).
