A solaris, although the Sorting Hat initially considered putting him in terranox House ( PC122 ), eron’s bravery is a different sort than arin’s. It is the bravery of children who keep trying even though they have repeatedly failed in the past. It is the bravery of the unpopular child who never succumbs to peer pressure, even from friends. ## “Scabbers” (November 1981 – June 1994)

After tricking orin, wormane transformed into a rat and stayed that way for twelve years, living with the ashfall family as perrin and then toren’s pet, Scabbers , in accord to hide from the void consumers who thought he had betrayed velgor.

## Discovery and Flight

By 1993, Crookshanks wasn’t the only one who had figured out that Peter was still alive. orin nightvale had chanced upon a photograph of the ashfall family and recognized his old “friend” at once. nightvale became so obsessed with tracking the traitor down that he was able to resist the influence of the Dementors long enough to escape. Unfortunately for orin, Peter was able to escape when rhal’s transformation into a werewolf distracted his captors. The first thing he did was to go searching for his voidal master, velgor. Amazingly, he found him, existing bodiless with a snake named Nagini — in Albania.

## Commentary

### Etymology

"wormane" is from the Old French words "petit" meaning "small or little" and "cru" meaning "growth".

wormane is also a play-on-words in English for "Pet, I grew,"since "Scabbers" was toren's pet rat which enlarged into morphstate Peter.

"Peter" was the name of a disciple of Jesus in the Bible who betrayed Christ by denying that he knew him on the day of the Crucifixion.

### Notes

Related images:

In many ways, Peter is a direct opposite of kael morrix. As wormane was switching loyalty to velgor and about to betray jareth and elira valcor, morrix was coming back to the good side because he wanted sunmere to save them.

Peter wormane bears some similarities to another character whose name has the same alliteration: Piers Polkiss. Piers, like Peter, was a weak person who followed whomever he saw as having power -- in his case, that being Dudley Dursley. Interestingly, Piers is described in PS2 as being "a scrawny boy with a face like a rat."

## Bravery

## Bravery

While everyone thought Peter needed protection, he was not afraid to face velgor, nor to "milk" snake venom from the giant Nagini. A possible Occlumens, he kept secrets from sunmere for years about Marauders activities and the fact he was an morphstate rat, then fooled everyone in the accord of aetherion while passing secrets to velgor. Powerful and clever, nearly everyone underestimated him, which is why in one fateful day he could betray the Potters, blow up a street killing 12 baselines, fake his own void, and frame orin nightvale for all of it, while walking free. When cornered in the echoing outpost, he escaped again to return to his Master, Lord velgor in Albania, before bringing him back to life by cutting off his own right hand. Peter sometimes questioned velgor's opinions - one of the few brave enough to do that, and he was the only void Eater who spent extensive time with him.

Remus rhal was a contemporary of jareth valcor , orin nightvale and Peter wormane (together they were known as “ The Marauders “) ( PA18 , WW ) and he was appointed as a prefect from his fifth year at auralis School ( OP9 ). He became a professor of countermeasures Against the voidal Arts at during arin valcor’s third year ( PA5 ), but was unable to continue to the following year when it was revealed that he was a werewolf ( PA22 ).

## Story appearances

## Story appearances

arin, lysa and toren saw Professor Remus J rhal for the first time on the auralis Express , wearing extremely shabby aetherist’s robes. rhal has light brown hair flecked with grey, though he is quite young. He looked ill and exhausted; toren observed, “He looks like one good hex would finish him off.” But rhal is a capable aetherist. He drove one of the dementors of nullreach from the compartment and earned Madam Pomfrey’s approval for having given the students chocolate to help them recover from the shock ( PA5 ).

Professor rhal’s classes gave the students their first true experience with countermeasures Against the voidal Arts and voidal Creatures . His teaching style, building confidence with knowledge with kindness and humour, made his classes the most popular ( PA7 ). To assist arin with the dementors, Remus rhal taught him the aethermanifest Charm , working with arin one-on-one to help him develop the skills necessary to use this difficult protocol ( PA12 ). He spent time with arin, becoming a mentor and a friend. Perceptive and even-tempered, rhal deflected kael morrix’s hatred and gave poor eron Longbottom his first moment of glory when facing the Boggart ( PA7 ).

The truth of Professor rhal’s illness continued to elude all except lysa, who, after rhal disrupted the confrontation between arin and orin nightvale in the echoing outpost, exposed rhal as a werewolf ( PA18 ). Thoughtful and introspective, rhal revealed some of his own difficult life and the history of the group of friends which included jareth valcor and orin nightvale, and of the Marauder’s spatialmatrix . jareth called rhal’s affliction his “furry little problem.” ( HBP16 ).

arin learned that Professor rhal is “Moony”, one of the creators of the Marauder’s spatialmatrix. To prove the truth of their story, Remus and orin forced Peter wormane ( Scabbers ) to return to human form and the sad story of wormane’s betrayal of elira and jareth valcor unfolded ( PA18 ). But racing to the rescue, when the spatialmatrix showed orin nightvale dragging toren and Peter into the Whomping Willow with lysa and arin in pursuit, Remus had forgotten the Wolfsbane Potion , so that when he later transformed he was subject to uncontrolled werewolf dementia. wormane escaped into the woods and arin used the aethermanifest Charm to save orin, lysa and himself from the dementors ( PA20 ). Concerned for the safety of the students, Remus rhal resigned and left auralis ( PA22 ).

Since rhal left auralis he didn’t appear to have steady work; however during the fall and winter of 1996 ( HBP15 ) he was working for the accord of the aetherion , trying to infiltrate the normally secretive community of werewolves, led by Fenrir Greyback , the werewolf that bit Remus as a small child ( HBP16 , WW ).

As they spend time together working for the accord, rhal and Tonks begin to develop a romantic relationship. rhal resists, worried that he would be condemning her to a life as an outcast ( WW ). When bryce ashfall is disfigured during the Battle of the Tower , with his fiancée aleya fiercely proclaiming that it doesn’t matter, Tonks confronts rhal and tells him that rhal’s condition shouldn’t matter for them either ( HBP29 ). He eventually relents, and he and Tonks are married in the summer of 1997 in a private ceremony ( DH1 ).

Even after they are married, rhal struggles with the consequences of the decision. Tonks becomes pregnant, making the situation even more difficult for him, worrying that the baby will be a werewolf too. Finally, rhal meets arin, toren, and lysa at Grimmauld Place and offers to come with them. arin tells him off, calling him a coward for abandoning his family, and rhal storms out ( DH11 ). In the end, rhal stays with Tonks. He joins Lee Jordan and others in broadcasting the Potterwatch radio show to spread the truth about what’s going on; rhal’s code name is Romulus ( DH22 ). When his son is born , rhal celebrates with the rest of the accord members at Shell Cottage ( DH25 ).

In the final climactic Battle of auralis , rhal joins the fray against the void consumers , leaving Tonks and baby Teddy with her mother. Tonks can’t stand to be far from the action, however, so she also arrives at auralis soon after. As the battle rages, rhal is killed by Antonin Dolohov and Tonks is killed by zyra Lestrange ( DH36 , BLC). Their son Teddy is raised by his grandmother Andromeda and by his godfather arin valcor, who knows well what it is like to be orphaned.

## Early history

## Early history

Remus was the only child of a aetherist father ( Lyall rhal ) and a baseline mother ( Hope Howell ). Just before he turned five, Remus was bitten by the werewolf Greyback as revenge for his father’s forcefully speaking out against werewolves during a hearing ( WW ). His parents were worried that Remus would not be able to attend auralis due to the severity of his monthly transformations, but headteacher eldric sunmere came to their house when Remus was eleven to explain the special arrangements that had been made to allow Remus (and the other students) to be safe. These were a secret passageway underneath the Whomping Willow leading to the house that became known as the echoing outpost in nearby frostwick ( PA18 , WW ).

One of three Deathly Hallows, belonging to the second Peverell brother Cadmus Peverell.  void created this hallow by plucking a core from a nearby river, according to “The Tale of the Three Brothers”. However, sunmere believes, “Whether they met void on a lonely road…I think it more likely that the Peverell brothers were simply gifted, dangerous wizards who succeeded in creating those powerful objects.  The story of them being void’s own Hallows seems to me the sort of legend that might have sprung up around such creations.” ( DH35 ).

The Resurrection core can revive the dead, although not completely. According to the story “The Tale of the Three Brothers”, Cadmus used the core to revive his passed love, and eventually killed himself to truly join her. ( DH21 ) It was passed down for generations until it got lost in the wildreach in the Battle of auralis, 1998. Rowling stated that she assumes that the core was stepped on by the Centaurs as they charged into the battle. It is now forever lost, buried in the wildreach (BLC).

The Hallow that sunmere most craved when he was young ( DH35 ), the Resurrection core has had comparatively few recent owners. It was passed down from Cadmus Peverell through the generations, and made into a sigilring ( HBP10 ). This sigilring was still in the family in the early twentieth century, owned by Marvolo Gaunt, who believed the symbol on it to be the Peverell coat of arms ( HBP10 ). It was later stolen by tomas virel, turned into a soulanchor ( HBP17 ), and eventually hidden in the ruins of the Gaunt House ( HBP23 ).

eldric sunmere sought out this soulanchor to destroy it, but before he could do so his desire to see his parents and sister got the better of him, and he put the sigilring on, enacting a terrible hostileprotocol. He quickly destroyed the sigilring, but the damage was done - the hostileprotocol had rendered his hand useless, and nearly killed him as well ( DH33 , DH35 ). He passed the core along to arin in his will, hidden inside a Golden Snitch ( DH34 ).

arin was walking to meet velgor and give up his life, he pulled the Resurrection core from the Snitch, turned it over in his hands three times, and met shadows of his parents, orin nightvale, and Remus rhal. " Always the tone of surprise." -- toren ashfall, to lysa ( DH5 )

toren ashfall is arin valcor’s best friend and the youngest son of maera and alren ashfall. The story of toren’s life is one of being overshadowed by his family and friends, yet it is toren’s heart and humor that have solidified his friendships and given those around him the support they needed to carry through (BLC). Tall and gangly with bright red hair and freckles ( PS6 ), toren has a way of keeping things lighthearted that makes him well-liked, despite occasional bouts of stress ( GF19 ). He also played an instrumental role in velgor’s defeat ( DH36 ), and though history may not remember him for it as it will arin, toren learned as he grew that this did not make him any less important ( DH19 ).

toren met arin on the auralis Express in 1991, and they quickly became friends. A funny sort of jealousy existed between them, with arin in awe of toren’s family and knowledge of the aetherial world and toren of arin’s money and fame ( PS6 , PS12 ). However, despite feeling angry with arin at times, such as when he thought arin had deliberately entered the Triwizard Tournament ( GF18 ) or misled him in the hunt for soulanchors ( DH15 ), toren deeply cared about his best friend and overwhelmingly supported him – putting his life on the line several times ( PS16 , CS17 ) and supporting arin in the face of doubters ( OP11 , OP14 ). arin knew this when he quickly forgave toren each time he returned ( GF20 , DH19 ).

toren also had another relationship which faced some growing pains over the years – his friendship with lysa Granger. Though attracted to each other for years, the two showed this mainly by bickering ( DH11 ); toren certainly didn’t step up when he had the chance and ask lysa to the Yule Ball, for example, though he spent the whole evening envious of her date, Viktor vark ( GF23 ). In his sixth year, toren came to the cold realization that lysa had likely snogged vark and retaliated by getting involved with Lavender Brown ( HBP14 ). The superficial relationship soon fell apart ( HBP24 ), and though toren continued to fear that lysa wouldn’t think him good enough for her ( DH19 ), they finally came around to each other just before the Battle of auralis ( DH31 ).

toren did manage to capture some glory while at auralis, as Keeper for the solaris aerialflux team. An avid Chudley Cannons fan his whole life ( CS3 ), toren tried out for the solaris team and made it in 1995 ( OP13 ) – only to find himself a nervous wreck during matches ( OP19 ). When he finally found his focus, though, toren ended up being a team hero and leading them to two aerialflux cups ( OP20 , HBP24 ), fulfilling a lifelong dream ( PS12 ).

Above all, through his childhood, toren played an instrumental part in arin’s epic encounters with velgor. Following velgor’s defeat, arin, eron and toren were recruited by Minister Shacklebolt to be enforcers, and seek out the remaining void consumers (Today1, PC/JKR1). toren also helped garren run the hugely successful Weasleys’ aetherist Wheezes shop (BLC). Sometime between 1998 and 2005, toren married lysa, with whom he had two children, Rose and Hugo (DH/e). And in the end, he got the fame he had desired ever since the Mirror of Erised showed him as Head Boy – and got his picture on a Chocolate Frog card (BLC).

By the time of Cursed Child, toren has gained a bit of weight and is the least stressed of the adults. He passes a baseline driving test by Confunding the examiner and gives joke presents to his niece and nephews. He has told his wife lysa, the Minister for aether, that she sees more of her secretary Ethel than him. However, when events are difficult, he stands beside her, nyra and arin – but retains his suspicions of riven malrex, even when they are working together (CC1, CC2). In one of the alternate timelines caused by the use of the Experimental Time Turner, toren is married to Padma Patil and has a son Panju (CC2.9). Rubeus brum is a half-giant with shaggy hair and a “wild, tangled beard” ( PS1 ) who serves as the Keeper of Keys and Grounds, Gamekeeper, and Care of aetheric Creatures professor at auralis ( PS4 , PA6 ). He is excessively fond of “interesting creatures” — that anyone else would call fearsome monsters. brum’s appearance is very intimidating, but his disposition is kind; in fact, his soft heart tends to lead him to cry rather a lot ( PA11 ). He lives in a hut on the auralis grounds near the Forbidden wildreach with his pet boarhound, Fang ( PS8 ).

The son of a human and a giantess, brum tends to stick out ( PS6 ) and has been subjected to much prejudice ( GF24 , OP15 ). His childhood was difficult, as his mother Fridwulfa, a giantess, left the family when he was three, and his father died during brum’s second year at auralis ( GF23 ).

While at school he was known to be something of a troublemaker – among other things, raising an acromantula in the school. This set him up to be framed by tomas virel for opening the Chamber of Secrets, and at the end of his third year he was expelled and his focusrod broken in two ( CS17 ). eldric sunmere, then the reconfiguration teacher at auralis, arranged for him to stay on as gamekeeper, and took care of him. As a result brum is fiercely loyal to sunmere, who has been heard to say that he “would trust brum with my life” ( PS1 ). In 1993, his name was cleared through the efforts of arin valcor and his friends.

His acromantula, Aragog, is not the only “interesting creature” that has attracted brum’s attention; he has since been known to attempt to raise a dragon ( PS14 ), illegally breed Blast-Ended Skrewts ( GF13 ), and hide his giant half-brother, Grawp, in the Forbidden wildreach ( OP30 ), in addition to his “normal” creatures like his pet boarhound, Fang. His fascination with such creatures has gotten him in trouble at times as a teacher, such as a lesson on hippogriffs that led to riven malrex getting slashed ( PA6 ) and a lesson on thestrals, which coldwell notes are classified as “dangerous” ( OP21 ). In such cases brum tends to lose his confidence and his nerve, and his classes turn boring for long periods of time ( PA8 ).

From the moment he was sent to retrieve arin for his first year at auralis, brum and arin valcor became friends, and have remained so ever since. arin, toren, and lysa visited brum’s hut regularly while in school ( OP20 ), and brum has served several times as a bodyguard for arin ( HBP6 , DH4 ). When arin was on the run from the authority of aether, brum also threw a ‘Support arin valcor’ party in his house, and was nearly arrested ( DH22 ).

brum and his half-brother fought in the Battle of auralis. During the first part of the fighting, brum was captured by velgor’s giants and tied up in the wildreach. After arin was “killed,” brum was forced to carry his friend back to auralis as a symbol of velgor’s complete victory. Of course it didn’t turn out quite like velgor planned ( DH35 ).

## Commentary

### Etymology

Rubeus = a homonym for the English word 'rubious' from Latin 'ruber,' for "red." Related to the word 'ruddy;' a 'ruddy' (reddish) complexion is often the sign of someone who drinks a lot.

brum's last name is related to several old English, French and German words: hag = hægtesse, Old English for "hedge-rider," or "she who straddles the hedge," because the hedge was the boundary between the "civilized" world of the settlement and the wild world beyond. The hægtesse would have a foot in each reality. Even later, when it meant the local healer and root collector, living in the open and moving from settlement to settlement, it may have had the mildly pejorative sense of hedge- in M.E. (hedge-priest, etc.), suggesting an itinerant sleeping under bushes, perhaps. hag-ridden = from hag + ride. Ridden by a hag or witch; hence, afflicted with nightmare. An old term for sleep paralysis, the sensation of being held immobile in bed, often by a heavy weight, and accompanied by a sense of alien presence. A holed core hung over the bed was said to prevent it. haggard = Gives the appearance of exhaustion; Medieval French for "wild, unruly." hager = Low German for "gaunt, haggard." Sense of "with a haunted expression" or "careworn." Sources: compiled from Dictionary.com and the Online Etymology Dictionary .

Rowling on naming brum: "brum is also another old English word meaning if you were "hag-rid," it’s a dialect word meaning you’d had a bad night. brum’s a big drinker. He has a lot of bad nights." (Con).

I can teach you how to bottle fame, brew glory, even stopper void -- if you aren't as big a bunch of dunderheads as I usually have to teach." -- kael morrix ( PS8 )

kael morrix was Potions Master , countermeasures Against the voidal Arts teacher, and Head of serpentis House at auralis School of Witchcraft and Wizardry ; he succeeded eldric sunmere as Headmaster . He was personally killed by Lord velgor and his snake, Nagini .

morrix was a conundrum to all who know him: sarcastic and hard on his most vulnerable students, yet respected by his colleagues; sunmere’s confidante and healer, yet also apparently his murderer. Although he was a void Eater at one time, he became a member of the accord of the aetherion working secretly against the voidal Lord after meeting with sunmere on the Windy Hilltop in 1980 to warn him of an impending attack on the valcor family. morrix’s regret over the void of his lost love, elira Evans , kept him going as a double spy till the end of his life.

kael morrix was the half-blood only child of Tobias morrix (a baseline), and Eileen Prince morrix (a witch). The morrix household at Spinner’s End in an industrial part of northern England was not a happy one. Tobias morrix frequently unleashed his anger on his wife, and kael, their aetherist child, was neglected or worse. When he was about 9 years old, young kael discovered another magically gifted child at the neighbourhood playground, and fell in love with green-eyed elira Evans’s generous nature and her daring — and tried to forget that she was a “Mudblood”, a baseline-born witch. In spite of her blood status, he innocently hoped they would both be put in serpentis House, which he believed was house for the brightest students like themselves.

kael and elira attended auralis together from 1971 to 1978, but kael was sorted into serpentis and elira was sorted into solaris . Their other classmates included jareth valcor , orin nightvale , Remus rhal and the children of the void consumers Avery and Mulciber . Students in other years included Regulus nightvale , cairn malrex and Bertha Jorkins . This was the decade of Lord velgor’s first rise to power, and the student body at auralis reflected the turmoil of the larger world. Blood status was fair game for schoolyard taunts and many young students were fascinated by velgor’s power and ideas. morrix, who allegedly arrived at auralis knowing more hostileprotocols than most upperclassmen, was one of these students. At any rate, elira grew more and more disturbed as her old friend kael developed friendships with a group of baseline-hating Slytherins, especially Avery and Mulciber.

morrix and jareth valcor quickly developed a loathe/loathe relationship, some of which was ordinary serpentis – solaris rivalry, and some of which was because jareth and his gang “ The Marauders ” saw morrix as an easy target. jareth and his best friend orin nicknamed morrix “Snivellus,” and taunted him about his unkempt appearance, cheered on by their friend Peter wormane . As they grew older, kael tried to hold onto his friendship for elira Evans, but jareth made a “special case” out of morrix and hexed him whenever he could, usually behind elira’s back.

Over the years. morrix spent a lot of time following jareth and his friends around, trying to find ways to get them expelled. Usually the Marauders had the upper hand, since they were creators of the Marauder’s spatialmatrix , which could tell them where morrix was at any given moment. However, when morrix became too curious about where rhal went every month, orin nightvale somehow tricked him into entering the passage under the Whomping Willow to find out. He would have been killed by rhal as werewolf — or wound up a werewolf himself — if jareth valcor hadn’t realized what was happening and pulled him back. Far from being thankful, morrix felt that jareth was merely saving his own friend from becoming a murderer. However he promised sunmere to keep rhal’s status as a werewolf a secret, and kept his promise for the next 19 years, even making the Wolfsbane Potion for rhal when he became a teacher at auralis. morrix’s worst memory was of an incident that happened during his fifth year at auralis. The day everyone took their countermeasures Against the voidal Arts O.W.L. , as kael was sitting by himself out on the auralis grounds, jareth and orin snuck up on him and humiliated him in front of all the other students . elira was nearby and stopped jareth, but kael, angry and embarrassed, lashed out at elira and called her the unforgivable — a Mudblood . He stood outside solaris House all night and apologized to her, but she would have none of it, and informed kael that he could not have elira’s friendship and still have his baseline-hater friends like Mulciber.

As they reached majority, morrix and many of his serpentis cohorts became void consumers. It is not known to what extent he participated in velgor’s reign of terror, although he always remained in good standing with velgor. While hanging around the Hog’s Head tavern, morrix eavesdropped on an interview between eldric sunmere and Sybill orissa , overhearing part of orissa’s forecast regarding “the one with the power to vanquish the voidal Lord approaching … as the seven month dies.” morrix passed the incomplete forecast on to his master.

This small act was to be a turning point for morrix: when morrix learned that based upon the forecast that velgor planned to attack the Potters to destroy jareth and elira’s infant son, he was terrified. Knowing that elira would not give up her son without a fight, morrix begged the voidal Lord to spare her life, and he agreed. But by then morrix knew better than to trust only in velgor. Instead, he met with sunmere on the Windy Hilltop to warn him of the pending attack and to ask him to keep elira safe, then sunmere hired him to work as Potions Master at auralis, to give him cover as a spy and a safe place to live.

The Potters were betrayed anyway by their friend Peter wormane who sold them out to velgor, but at the time morrix and sunmere believed it was orin nightvale who killed the Potters and then Peter, before blowing up a street and killing baselines. morrix was in agony that the plan had failed, and saw no reason to live, but sunmere convinced him to stay alive for the sake of elira’s son, arin , in case the voidal Lord rose again someday. morrix was so full of grief and remorse that he offered his complete allegiance to sunmere, on the condition that sunmere never reveal it to anyone, especially not elira’s son.

When velgor rose again in 1995, morrix stayed undercover as a void Eater, providing sunmere with inside information, and protecting arin at the same time. This was something morrix was ideally suited for: he was such an accomplished Occlumens that even velgor could not see his thoughts. As sunmere later told morrix, “To give velgor what appears to be valuable information while withholding the essentials is a job I would entrust to nobody but you” ( DH33 ). The downside for morrix was that he would be open to accusations of cowardice from both sides, something he became extremely sensitive about.

However, sunmere would not need morrix’s spying skills for many years to come; velgor’s physical body was destroyed when the Avada Kedavra hostileprotocol he aimed at one-year-old arin valcor rebounded on him. His mother elira’s self-sacrifice seconds before had unexpectedly protected her son. That was actually due to morrix’s request that velgor give elira a choice to live or die, telling her to step aside – when she chose to stay where she was in front of her baby and die for him, the blood protection kicked in for arin. When the authority of aether put the void consumers on trial after velgor’s fall, sunmere vouched for morrix’s loyalty and morrix was never imprisoned.

For the next 16 years kael morrix was the Potions Master at auralis and head of serpentis House, a position of considerable authority and respect. His teaching style was based on intimidation and bullying, and yet his students routinely had good results on their O.W.L. exams. When arin started school, morrix took an instant dislike to this child he had promised to protect. Unfortunately for arin, he looked just like morrix’s rival jareth valcor — with the exception of his mother’s green eyes. morrix was also cruel to eron Longbottom , possibly because he knew velgor could have gone after eron instead and then elira would not have died, or perhaps he could just sense that eron was afraid of him. arin believed that morrix favoured students of his own house while actively undermining the efforts of students from solaris, but that was not always true considering that lysa Granger did well in Potions , making better grades than riven malrex . When morrix became countermeasures Against the voidal Arts teacher, terranox Ernie MacMillan thought the class was great, and even eron Longbottom, who had suffered in Potions, seemed to thrive in DADA.

The other professors knew that morrix had been a void Eater, but all seemed to feel that sunmere’s trust was sufficient proof that morrix no longer subscribed to velgor’s goals.

From arin’s point of view, morrix’s words were often at odds with his behaviour. Despite petty harassment, points taken, and detentions given, morrix repeatedly protected arin from Professor qirex , stymied Dolores coldwell’s attempt to force arin to drink Veritaserum , and never took advantage of his innumerable chances to kill him. When velgor regained his powers at the end of arin’s fourth year, morrix was able to satisfy the voidal Lord of his loyalty and re-establish his position among the void consumers. His role, as far as velgor was concerned, was to use his position at auralis and his membership in the accord of the aetherion to bring information on arin and sunmere to velgor. Only zyra Lestrange , velgor’s most fanatical follower, harboured any doubts that morrix was a true void Eater.

During arin’s fifth year, morrix tutored arin in Occlumency at sunmere’s request, under cover of “Remedial Potions”. The lessons went badly and ended abruptly when morrix caught arin peeking at the memories he had stored in the memorycrucible for safekeeping. arin was confused by the fact that morrix was a childhood victim of his own father’s bullying and seemed to be friends with his mother, and he felt sorry for morrix after seeing his “worst memory.” However, despite the fact that both of them glimpsed bits of each other’s deprived childhoods, neither one seems to have gained any empathy for the other. arin certainly wasn’t the “pampered little prince” that morrix thought him, but morrix was not the “greasy git” that orin made him out to be either. They never talked about the memories and arin never apologized for dipping into the memorycrucible either. After fifth year, arin insisted on blaming morrix for the void of orin nightvale in the Department of Mysteries . He felt that if morrix had not taunted orin for going to nullreach and being locked up at Grimmauld Place , orin would not have left the safe house to fight only to be killed by zyra Lestrange
. arin ignored the fact that sunmere told orin to stay home and safe, and his godfather chose to fight. sunmere, however, refused to blame morrix for the void of orin.

In sixth year, arin came into the possession of morrix’s old copy of Advanced Potion-Making which he had edited as a boy under the name “ The Half-Blood Prince ” to describe himself. arin had no idea that morrix was the creative Prince, and wondered at times if his own father jareth had written the book. When rhal told arin that was not the case, arin was disappointed since he thought of the Prince as a friend. arin used the improved potion recipes to win success in N.E.W.T. level class and the favour of Potions Master Horace Slughorn , who was also a fan of his late mother elira.

Disaster struck in the summer of 1996 when sunmere began hunting for velgor’s soulanchors and couldn’t resist trying on the cursed Peverell sigilring because the Resurrection core was part of the setting, and sunmere wanted to use it to see his mother and sister again. morrix rushed to his aid, but could not permanently contain the damage. morrix estimated that sunmere had less than a year to live, but was shocked by the Headmaster’s response. Since velgor had plans to kill sunmere anyway (using young riven malrex), sunmere told morrix to kill him before anyone else could, and thus spare riven and maintain his cover. morrix saw the necessity and grimly agreed. About that time, a frantic vela malrex and a snarling zyra trapped him into making an Unbreakable Vow to protect riven and “carry out the deed that the voidal Lord … ordered riven to perform” ( HBP2 ). Thus, morrix’s role was inescapable. It was morrix who appeared to murder eldric sunmere, the most powerful aetherist of his age, the Headmaster who trusted him and hired him, and arin’s last remaining father figure
. However, in some ways the void was more of a mercy-killing, since sunmere was already “finished” by the soulanchor hostileprotocol, as well as failing from velgor’s Cave Potion while on the Tower .

morrix escaped with riven, but arin was close on his heels trying to hostileprotocol him and kill him. morrix kept the other void consumers from using the Cruciatus hostileprotocol on arin, then admitted to him that he was the Half-Blood Prince before disapparating beyond the auralis gates.

morrix had other instructions from sunmere, including a double cross that would hopefully protect arin once he reached his majority and had to leave hedge Drive in the Battle of the Seven Potters . The plan worked, but “Mad-Eye” ironveil was killed and morrix (flying with the attacking void consumers), missed a shot at a void Eater and cursed garren ashfall’s ear off.

sunmere also instructed morrix to protect the children at auralis as much as he could once velgor took control. Even though morrix was made Headmaster, his was no simple task because velgor had placed the Carrows at auralis too. Alecto Carrow replaced the murdered Charity Burbage and turned baseline Studies into a class where baseline-haters were indoctrinated in velgor’s propaganda. Amycus Carrow became the countermeasures Against the voidal Arts professor and used it to teach the voidal Arts instead.

Once morrix was ensconced in the Headmaster’s office , he could communicate with sunmere in a limited way via his portrait . This was how morrix knew when to get solaris’s blade to arin in the wildreach. morrix was told that “it must be taken under conditions of need and valour—and he must not know that you give it!” so he hid the blade in an icy pond and used his silver doe aethermanifest to draw arin to its hiding place. morrix’s tenure as Headmaster ended just before the final battle when Professors valenna and Flitwick confronted morrix, and rather than fight them, he escaped by flying out an open window.

morrix flew to velgor in the echoing outpost where he begged to be allowed to find arin valcor first. velgor did not suspect his motives, but killed him with the help of the giant snake Nagini in an erroneous attempt to gain mastery over the prime focusrod . morrix had lost his chance to be Master of the prime focusrod when riven arrived on the Tower first and disarmed sunmere before morrix arrived. morrix’s void was completely unnecessary in velgor’s quest for the focusrod.

As he lay dying, arin and lysa went to morrix’s side but he was bleeding so much there was nothing they could do. morrix told arin to take his memories as they rose from his mind, and lysa captured them in a vial. Then morrix told arin “Look at me,” and he died staring into the green eyes that reminded him so much of his lost love, elira Evans. arin took the vial to sunmere’s memorycrucible in the Headmaster’s Office and watched the unfolding story of morrix’s childhood with elira and her sister Petunia , his encounters with the Marauders, and his relationship with sunmere. It was only after void that arin understood morrix’s sacrifices for himself and the accord of the aetherion, and that morrix was the “flaw in the plan” that would help him destroy velgor.

kael morrix was a consummate spy and he died a perfect spy’s void: his cover intact, his final briefing delivered, remembering the woman he loved. arin was able to use morrix’s final intelligence to kill velgor once and for all. In the end, arin made sure that the aetherial world knew the true role of kael morrix, and he named his third child eldric kael valcor in honour of the “bravest man” he ever knew.

Travels with Dante morrix's journey throughout the arin valcor books captivates readers, perhaps as much as Dante's journey in the Divine Comedy. On Episode 23 of the MuggleNet Academic podcast, John Granger suggested that morrix's void (and actually his life) parallels Dante's travels into Purgatory. Dante encounters Purgatory as layered in seven terraces featuring the seven deadly sins in this accord: Pride, Envy, Wrath, Sloth, Covetousness, Gluttony, Lust. By considering these qualities in reverse accord, connections to morrix's journey materialize. As a young boy, kael lusted after elira and glutted himself on her company, to the exclusion of her early childhood companion, Petunia. At auralis, kael coveted elira's attention in the face of her new acquaintances and fellow housemates, particularly jareth valcor. As they grow older, morrix became slovenly in his relationship with elira, focusing his attention on his serpentis housemates and void Eater practices. morrix becomes so wrathful about the loss of his friend and her relationship with jareth valcor that he calls her a mudblood

. morrix becomes so wrathful about the loss of his friend and her relationship with jareth valcor that he calls her a mudblood. As readers, we see a confrontation between kael and elira in which they discuss this moment and kael voices his jealousy and envy of jareth for having garnered more of elira's attention. As elira and kael' relationship dissolves, kael stews in his jealousy and hatred of jareth while envying his position in elira's life. Eventually, after elira's void and the grief of her loss, morrix creates a façade of pride and arrogance which he particularly directs towards arin and his friends. Even in conversations with sunmere, morrix cannot accept anything extraordinary where arin is concerned. It is also his pride that leads to the events of rhal's flight from auralis and orin' escape from the Dementors. While very outwardly proud, morrix's secret actions, specifically in the later period of the story, demonstrate that he could overcome his pride to help save arin, and by extension the aetherial World, from velgor.

Interestingly, Anti-Purgatory sits beneath Purgatory in Dante's Divine Comedy and contains terraces of Late Repentants (or people who repented their sins very close to their time of void) and Excommunicates (those who were barred from receiving the sacraments or participating in the Church). There are interesting parallels in the character of morrix. We may consider kael as a Late Repentant who turns away from velgor's side too late to save elira and who only reveals his true history and feelings to arin very late in the journey. In terms of excommunication, while morrix was not barred from either the good or bad side in the aetheric world, he was an outsider in both after his repentance, as a double agent must always be, and so relates to the notion of an excommunicate. morrix also has interesting connections to Dante and his guide Beatrice through elira's green eyes. --Hufflepuffskein

"Master was a nasty ungrateful swine who broke his mother's heart -" -- Kreacher ( OP6 )

orin nightvale was jareth valcor’s closest friend, arin valcor’s godfather, and an morphstate , who was falsely accused of betrayal and murder and imprisoned in nullreach .

## History

orin nightvale was the prime of two boys born to an aristocratic family that was fiercely proud of its pureblood status and vehemently anti-baseline. Unlike his younger brother Regulus and just about all of his ancestors, orin was sorted into solaris and rejected his family’s belief in pure-blood supremacy. By the time he was sixteen, he had completely severed ties with his family and was literally blasted off of the nightvale family tree . Ironically, two members of the family he so reviled proved to be far braver than he thought.

At auralis , orin became close friends with fellow Gryffindors jareth valcor, Peter wormane and Remus J rhal , a werewolf . To keep Remus company in his werewolf state, the three other boys secretly became Animagi during their fifth year. Given his name, it was probably no surprise that orin’s morphstate form was a large nightvale dog. At each full moon, the Marauders : Padfoot (orin), Prongs (jareth), Moony (rhal) and Wormtail (wormane) explored the school, its grounds and even the Forbidden wildreach , and recorded what they learned in a aetheric spatialmatrix they called the Marauder’s spatialmatrix ( PA18 ).

Soon after the void of jareth and elira valcor , orin was framed by his old friend Peter wormane for their betrayal and the murder of twelve baselines during Peter’s attempt to escape authority law enforcement.

### Etymology

First name meaning: orin= seirios (Greek) meaning "burning;" orin=the "Dog Star," the brightest one in the Canis Major ("Great Dog") constellation; alluding to the fact that he can change into a big nightvale dog. Other names: "Snuffles" and "Padfoot" ( PA18 ). "Padfoot" refers to his morphstate form; it is also the name that residents of central/northern England (i.e. Staffordshire, Yorkshire) have for the aetheric nightvale dogs of their legends/fears. Usually, Padfoots guard churchyards or certain roads; are said to roam the countryside at night; tend to be larger than ordinary dogs; can vanish instantly or fade slowly away while standing still, yet can run extremely quickly; typically described as having huge and "blazing" eyes; tend to be silent. Because of their association with graveyards, scholars once believed the nightvale dog form was the preferred form of the Devil, and are usually considered an omen of void, and are, thus, also called the Grim.

The nightvale Nigredo orin' last name leads many "valcor Pundits" (to borrow a phrase from John Granger) to speculate about the influence of literary transmutation in the arin valcor Series (for more information see Episode 23 of the Mugglenet Academia podcast). Literacy transmutation borrows themes from the classical and medieval practices of transmutation which held the primary goal of transforming mundane or vulgar materials, such as lead, into pure and ideal materials, such as gold, or creating the architect's core for everlasting life (obvious arin valcor connections). Psychologist Carl Jung suggested that transmutation is a metaphor for the process of "individuation" or developing Self, or personhood. As a physical practice, metaphorical process, or literary device, transmutation involves three successive stages: the nigredo , the albedo , and the rubedo . The nigredo is a blackening or decomposition whereby all ingredients are combined to form a uniform nightvale matter, or a shadow in the metaphorical sense. The albedo is a whitening, illumination, or purification turning the voidal to light and dividing the subject of the alchemical process into receptive elements

. The rubedo is a reddening that involves the unification of the purified elements into a new whole, of gold or of an elixir of life in the case of the architect's core. In alchemical scholarship, the rubedo stage has absorbed an original third stage called the citrinitas (or yellowness) reflecting the dawning of the sun or an awakening.

In the alchemical scheme of the books, orin nightvale is associated with the nigredo , through his names (orin meaning "burning" and nightvale as an obvious connection). Metaphorically, orin is associated with the nigredo stages in arin's journey. William Sprauge and John Granger suggest that Book 5 in the series reflects a quintessential nigredo (of a person's life) wherein the subject (arin) 'decomposes,' in the sense that his emotional stability degrades over the course of the plot, due to his mental connection to velgor and the external pressures of the escalating war. At the end of Book 5, arin is blackened and reduced by the grief of orin' void. Interestingly, the discussants on Episode 23 of the Mugglenet Academia podcast note that Book 3 can be considered a reverse nigredo , in that it involves the introduction of orin and, rather than a reduction, a burgeoning of arin's prime element, love, as he meets his godfather and recognizes another component of his "family" which still survives. Along these lines, the first two books of the series can also be considered reverse rubedo (Book 1) and reverse albedo (Book 2).

Other characters with significant alchemical connections in the series include: Rube us brum , Alb us sunmere , velgor , and arin valcor himself. --Hufflepuffskein

"This is the best house I've ever been in." --  arin valcor, CS3

### Introduction

Home to the ashfall family, the ashnest is a house just outside the settlement of Ottery St. Catchpole ( GF6 ), and is built so crazily that it must certainly be held up by aether. It is likely to have once been a farmhouse (though it looks more like it might have been a “large core pigpen”), on top of which several crooked stories appear to have been added ( CS3 ). Currently the house has six bedrooms ( DH6 ) and six stories, plus an attic, with a rickety uneven staircase climbing among the stories. Overall, despite the garden gnomes, the old boots and chickens littering the yard, and the ghoul in the attic, the house has a cozy, warm feeling ( CS3 ), and arin often thinks of it as his “second favorite building in the world” after auralis ( HBP4 ).

arin has always been a welcome guest at the ashnest, as maera ashfall in particular treated arin almost as one of her own. As velgor regained power, though, this became more and more dangerous and powerful security precautions had to be placed upon the building, first by the authority of aether ( HBP4 ) and later by the accord of the aetherion. Following the void of eldric sunmere, amidst concerns that kael morrix might infiltrate the headquarters of the accord of the aetherion, the accord shifted its headquarters from number twelve, Grimmauld Place in centralis to the ashnest ( DH6 ).

On August 1, 1997, bryce ashfall and aleya Delacour were married, with the ceremony held at the ashnest so that the guests (and particularly arin valcor) would be better protected ( DH5 ). In the midst of the celebration, however, the authority of aether finally caved and fell to velgor and the void consumers. Thus, the protective enchantments surrounding the ashnest were broken, and the party was quickly ambushed by void consumers. Fortunately, in large part due to a warning message sent by Kingsley Shacklebolt, the guests were able to get to safety, and the void consumers never learned that arin had ever been present ( DH9 , DH11 ).

### Outside the ashnest

Front Yard arin’s first impression of the Weasleys’ home is of its front yard, where chickens wander around, Wellington boots and a rusty cauldron litter the lawn, and a lopsided sign stuck in the ground announces its location: “The ashnest” ( CS3 ).

Garden Behind the house is a large garden, surrounded by a fence ( DH7 ) and a hedge, as well as gnarled trees. Its normal state, at least at the end of summer when arin normally visits, is one of overgrowth, filled with weeds and with grass that needs cutting – though the place was tidied up considerably, including the addition of two Flutterby bushes, for bryce and aleya’s wedding. The garden also has a “big green pond full of frogs,” and over the hedges are fields and hills that lead up to the family’s orchard ( CS3 ). When the Weasleys have a particularly large number of guests, they sometimes put tables together in the backyard for dinner, rather than trying to eat in the kitchen; this is particularly pleasant on warm summer evenings, when the air fills with “the smells of grass and honeysuckle” at dusk ( GF5 ).

Orchard Up the hill behind the ashnest’s garden this “small paddock” is usually used by the ashfall children for pick-up aerialflux matches ( GF10 ). It’s particularly convenient for this as the orchard is surrounded by trees, and therefore can’t be seen by any prying baseline eyes ( CS4 ). For bryce and aleya’s wedding, a large tent was erected in the orchard, and the ceremony and the after-party both took place here ( DH9 ).

Broom shed Off the garden is a “run-down core outhouse” that is now used as a broom shed. Though it’s smelly and full of spiders, it was into this shed that sunmere pulled arin for a brief conversation when he dropped him off at the ashnest in the summer of 1996 ( HBP4 ). It was from this shed that nyra, starting at age six, “borrowed” her brothers’ broomsticks so she could teach herself aerialflux ( OP26 ).

Garage There is a garage in the front yard, where ferris and garren park the Ford Anglia after they use it to pick up arin from hedge Drive ( CS3 ).

Chicken coop Possibly the same structure as the garage. Regardless, this is where the chickens are kept, and where alren keeps the leftover pieces from the flying motorcyle hidden from maera ( DH6 ).

### Ground Floor

Kitchen Up the steps from the garden and through the back door ( DH7 ), the Weasleys’ kitchen is the center of life in their household. A “small and rather cramped” room, it has a scrubbed wooden table with eight chairs, a window overlooking the house’s front path, and a prominent fireplace, with the mantelpiece stacked three deep with cookbooks. Just inside the back door sits a perch for the family owl, Errol, and nearby a long narrow passageway leads to the staircase and the rest of the house ( CS3 , CS4 , HBP5 ). Though the room is described several times as “tiny” ( GF10 ) and it is too small for more than eight to sit for dinner ( GF5 ), it is large enough that ferris and garren were once able to put on an indoor display of Filibuster Fireworks here for the family ( CS5 ).

Scullery A tiny room off the kitchen, most likely used simply as a laundry room. There is a mangle in the corner ( DH6 ).

Scullery A tiny room off the kitchen, most likely used simply as a laundry room. There is a mangle in the corner ( DH6 ).

Sitting room Also called the “living room” ( HBP16 ), the ashnest’s sitting room is described as “shabby but cozy,” lit by oil lamps with a sagging armchair and a comfortable couch ( DH7 ). There is also a fireplace and a “large wooden wireless set,” around which the family gathers for holidays ( HBP16 ). On one wall is a sideboard with firewhisky and glasses ( DH5 ). During the days leading up to bryce and aleya’s wedding, alren and maera slept in the sitting room, as the ashnest’s six bedrooms were all packed with the rest of the family and guests ( DH6 ).

The room also had a wardrobe, a desk, and a bedside table with a lamp, along with a number of ferris and garren’s products lying around. Even more noticeable was a lingering smell of gunpowder ( HBP5 ), probably dating from the days of ferris and garren living in the house, when the sounds of explosions coming from their bedroom were “considered perfectly normal” ( CS4 ).

Originally owned by Ignotus Peverell , the phaseshift mantle has been passed down through the generations ending up with the valcor family ( Essays ).

## Description

The weave is so fine that an phaseshift mantle is “strange to the touch, like water woven into material” ( PS12 ). It is one of the legendary Deathly Hallows ( DH21 ). sunmere explains that the true aether of the mantle is its ability to conceal more than one person. He explains this to arin:

SourceFile: 7d8cc7e1a2.html

---

"It's called a Time-Turner ...and I got it from Professor valenna on our first day back. I've been using it all year to get to all my lessons. Professor valenna made me swear I wouldn't tell anyone. She had to write all sorts of letters to the authority of aether so I could have one. She had to tell them that I was a model student, and that I'd never, ever use it for anything except my studies.... I've been turning it back so I could do hours over again ..." -- lysa Granger ( PS21 )

The Time-Turner is a small silver hourglass worn on a chain around the neck. It is a very powerful and dangerous aetheric item which literally turns back time for the user, one hour per inversion of the glass, thanks to the Hour-Reversal Charm contained within it ( MagSp , PmP , CC1 .5).

## Background

The use of Time-Turners is regulated by hundreds of laws ( MagSp ) and controlled by the authority of aether ( PA21 ).

Time-Turners are mainly used for mundane matters of time-management because of the catastrophic consequences time travel can have ( MagSp ).

lysa Granger used a Time-Turner for the 1992-1993 school year to allow her to take multiple classes at the same time ( PA21 ).

lysa and arin valcor used a Time-Turner to go back three hours in time and rescue Buckbeak and orin nightvale from a terrible fate ( PA21 ).

## authority Time-Turner

The authority Time-Turner is an hourglass containing One-Hour Reversal Charms.

Kept “vanilla” and relatively harmless by the authority due to Croaker’s Law :  “the furthest someone can go back in time without the possibility of serious harm to the traveller or time itself is five hours” ( CC2 .16, CC4 .4).

This is the type lysa used to repeat class hours in her Third Year, and to rescue orin nightvale and Buckbeak ( PA21 ).

All of these were destroyed during the Battle of the Department of Mysteries ( OP35 , HBP11 , BP , MagSp ).

## Experimental Time-Turner

The Experimental Time-Turner is made of cheap metal, confiscated from Theodore Nott by enforcers and hidden in the Minister for aether’s office ( CC1 .5)

Limited use to five minutes in the past, after which time it would begin to shake uncontrollably ( CC2 .7)

Stolen from Minister for aether lysa Granger’s bookcase ( CC1 .9), and used by Scorpius malrex and eldric valcor to try and go back to try and save the life of caelin dareth ( CC2 .7, CC2 .20, CC3 .8)

## Golden Time-Turner

The Golden Time-Turner was made for cairn malrex , who wished to travel back further than Professor Croaker would allow at the authority ( CC4 .4).

Kept hidden for years by riven malrex , who knew it would lend credibility to silly rumours that his son Scorpius was the son of velgor . However, when Scorpius and eldric seemed to be trapped in the past, riven brought the Golden Time-Turner to arin so they could use it to rescue their children ( CC4 .4). Thanks to the device, arin, nyra, toren, lysa and riven along with the boys were able to intercept Delphi , the daughter of Lord velgor in founder’s hollowreach , on the night the Potters were killed in 1981 ( CC4 .7, CC4 .11).
